jobs.title: Translation Program Coordinator - Spanish
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

At Lucile Packard Children’s Hospital Stanford, we know world\-renowned care begins with world\-class caring. That's why we combine advanced technologies and breakthrough discoveries with family\-centered care. It's why we provide our caregivers with continuing education and state\-of\-the\-art facilities, like the newly remodeled Lucile Packard Children's Hospital Stanford. And it's why we need caring, committed people on our team \- like you. Join us on our mission to heal humanity, one child and family at a time.  

  

**Job ID:** LP\_011096\-2240

 **Job Description** **JOB SUMMARY**


This paragraph summarizes the general nature, level and purpose of the job.


The Translation Program Coordinator is responsible for developing, coordinating and managing translation services, for training and assessment of staff, interns and volunteers for translation services. Conducts medical and general interpreting/translating for staff, patients, and families for Stanford Health Services and other contracting institutions. Ensures translation process is followed according to department guidelines.

 **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**


The essential functions listed are typical examples of work performed by positions in this job classification. They are not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, tasks, and responsibilities. Employees may also perform other duties as assigned.


Employees must abide by all Joint Commission Requirements including but not limited to sensitivity to cultural diversity, patient care, patient rights and ethical treatment, safety and security of physical environments, emergency management, teamwork, respect for others, participation in ongoing education and training, communication and adherence to safety and quality programs, sustaining compliance with National Patient Safety Goals, and licensure and health screenings.


Must perform all duties and responsibilities in accordance with the hospital's policies and procedures, including its Service Standards and its Code of Conduct.

* Coordinates workflow of all translation assignments, including delegating translation assignments and ensuring successful completion of all assigned projects.
* Develops policies, financial planning and organization of the translation program.
* Edits all translations providing feedback to the translation team including monitoring the translators' performance and providing feedback.
* Ensures translation process is followed according to department guidelines.
* Handles requests for translations from external customers including other hospitals, pharmaceutical companies and outside institutions.
* Communicates and manages the procedure, payment, and delivery timeframe.
* Coordinates with outside contractors for certain languages and establishes working relationships with contractors and vendors.
* Responsible for invoicing, billing and collection upon delivery of final product for external customers.
* Handles requests for translations from the hospital units and clinics and assigns work orders to in house translators.
* Must possess high verbal and written skills in both English and the appropriate language.
* Organizes educational translation meetings and prepares presentations on translation topics such as grammar, punctuation, medical terminology, etc) in staff meetings.
* Performs all functions listed under the job description for translator.
* Responsible for Translation quality including edits to all Spanish translations including format, grammar, syntax, usage, spelling, etc.
* Reviews delivery of assignments of electronic files and ensures fonts are legible (Asian, Arabic, Russian languages).

 **Qualifications** **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**


Any combination of education and experience that would likely provide the required knowledge, skills and abilities as well as possession of any required licenses or certifications is qualifying.

**Education:** Bachelor's degree in a work\-related discipline/field from an accredited college or university.

**Experience:** Three (3\) years of progressively responsible and directly related work experience.

**Licensure/Certification:** ATA certification required. ATA certification may be waived with a master's degree in Translation.

 **KNOWLEDGE**


These are the observable and measurable attributes and skills required to perform successfully the essential functions of the job and are generally demonstrated through qualifying experience, education or licensure/certification.

* Ability to adjust communications to fit the needs and level of understanding of the receiver.
* Ability to establish and maintain excellent client relationships, exhibit exemplary interpersonal skills and exercise sound judgment and professionalism in business and personnel matters.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality of sensitive information.
* Ability to remain calm under pressure and apply sound judgment
* Ability to solve problems and identify solutions.
* Ability to work well with individuals at all levels of the organization.
* Knowledge of cultural and perceptual factors that may affect patient treatment and communication Knowledge of Medical Terminology.

 **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**


The Physical Requirements and Working Conditions in which the job is typically performed are available from the Occupational Health Department. Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

 **Additional Information** **Pay Range**  

Compensation is based on the level and requirements of the role.  

Salary within our ranges may also be determined by your education, experience, knowledge, skills, location, and abilities, as required by the role, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.  

Typically, new team members join at the minimum to mid salary range.  

Minimum to Midpoint Range (Hourly): $45\.93 to $51\.54

jobs.title: Project Manager – Afterschool Programs
jobs.description:
Project Manager – Afterschool Programs

**CAM Educational Services (CAM Edu)**

**Pay:** $28\.00–$30\.00 per hour  
**Job Type:** Part\-Time  
**Work Location:** Millbrae, South San Francisco (SSF), and San Mateo, CA  
**Work Setting:** In Person

About CAM Educational Services

CAM Educational Services is an innovative educational organization providing high\-quality afterschool tutoring, childcare, and enrichment programs in partnership with schools and communities throughout California.

We are looking for an experienced, organized, and dependable **Project Manager – Afterschool Programs** to support the successful operation of our programs across **Millbrae, South San Francisco, and San Mateo**.

This is an excellent opportunity for an education professional, program coordinator, site supervisor, project manager, or experienced youth\-program leader who enjoys working with children, supporting staff, and building strong relationships with schools and communities.

About the Role

The Project Manager will oversee and support the day\-to\-day operations of assigned CAM Edu afterschool programs. This position requires strong leadership, communication, organization, and problem\-solving skills.

The Project Manager will work closely with instructors, site staff, school administrators, families, and CAM Edu leadership to ensure programs are properly staffed, organized, safe, engaging, and aligned with school and district expectations.

Key Responsibilities

* Oversee daily operations of assigned afterschool programs.
* Coordinate and support instructors, childcare staff, tutors, and other program team members.
* Ensure assigned programs are adequately staffed and operational.
* Monitor staff attendance, punctuality, schedules, and classroom coverage.
* Assist with staff scheduling and make adjustments based on program needs.
* Conduct regular site visits to monitor program operations and quality.
* Communicate regularly with school administrators and CAM Edu leadership.
* Build and maintain positive relationships with school and district partners.
* Support staff onboarding, training, coaching, and professional development.
* Monitor classroom quality, student engagement, and classroom management.
* Ensure staff follow CAM Edu policies, procedures, and safety expectations.
* Address staff, student, parent, and school concerns professionally and promptly.
* Assist with incident reporting, attendance tracking, and required documentation.
* Monitor program supplies, classroom materials, equipment, and other resources.
* Ensure classrooms are safe, clean, organized, and prepared for daily programming.
* Support implementation of curriculum, enrichment activities, and program schedules.
* Track staffing needs, operational concerns, and follow\-up items.
* Provide regular updates and reports to CAM Edu management.
* Identify opportunities to improve program quality, efficiency, and staff performance.
* Assist with launching and supporting new school programs and initiatives.
* Perform additional duties and projects as assigned by management.

Leadership \& Staff Support

The Project Manager will serve as a key resource for program staff and will be expected to:

* Provide clear direction and expectations to staff.
* Support instructors with classroom\-management and student\-related concerns.
* Monitor employee attendance, performance, and professionalism.
* Identify staffing gaps and communicate coverage needs promptly.
* Provide coaching and constructive feedback.
* Help maintain a positive, respectful, and collaborative work environment.
* Escalate employee concerns to CAM Edu leadership when appropriate.

School \& Community Relations

* Maintain professional communication with school administrators, teachers, and district representatives.
* Respond to school requests and follow up on operational concerns.
* Represent CAM Edu professionally at assigned school sites.
* Build positive relationships with school staff, families, and community partners.
* Help ensure programs meet school and district expectations.
* Support CAM Edu's long\-term partnerships with schools and communities.

Qualifications

* Experience in education, afterschool programs, childcare, youth development, program coordination, or project management preferred.
* Previous leadership, supervisory, or program\-management experience strongly preferred.
* Experience supporting or managing teams of employees.
* Experience working with school\-age children and youth programs.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously.
* Strong attention to detail and follow\-through.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating with CAM Edu leadership.
* Professional, dependable, flexible, and solution\-oriented attitude.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced educational environment.
* Bachelor's degree in Education, Business Administration, Management, Child Development, or a related field preferred but not required with relevant experience.

Work Expectations

* Part\-time position.
* Must be available to work in person at assigned school sites.
* Must be willing to support programs in **Millbrae, South San Francisco, and San Mateo**.
* Must be flexible with scheduling based on school and program needs.
* Must be available to travel between assigned sites when needed.
* Reliable transportation is strongly preferred.
* Must be responsive to time\-sensitive staffing and operational matters.
* Must be comfortable working with children, school personnel, families, and employees.
* Must maintain professionalism and confidentiality when handling student, employee, and school information.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is:

* Organized, dependable, and proactive.
* A strong and professional communicator.
* Comfortable leading and supporting staff.

jobs.title: Scaled Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI\-powered user interviews.


Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

  

The research industry is massive (\>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high\-cost services. That's our opportunity.

  

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures.


The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people.


We’re a tight\-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.


As a Scaled Customer Success Manager, you'll own adoption, retention, and growth across a mature portfolio of 100–200\+ accounts in our Scaled segment — and you'll build the systems that make covering a book that size possible.


You'll determine the right signals, automate analysis and follow\-ups, and design an operating model that gives customers an excellent experience. Roughly 70% of your time will be portfolio management; the other 30% will be building the infrastructure and process behind it — working closely with RevOps, Marketing, and Engineering.


This is a foundational hire. The health scoring, playbooks, and operating cadences you build will be the ones the team runs on for years, and you'll help define what "Scaled" means at Outset as the segment grows.

**Responsibilities**

* Own adoption, retention, and expansion outcomes across a portfolio of 100–200\+ Scaled accounts, from onboarding through renewal
* Keep usage and adoption high in a deliberately lower\-touch model — leverage programs, automation, and self\-service before reaching for a calendar invite
* Monitor account health and usage signals to catch risk and expansion opportunities early, and prioritize where your direct time actually changes the outcome
* Run renewals across a mixed model of actively managed and auto\-renewing accounts, partnering with our broader CS team on commercial approach
* Build and run one\-to\-many programs: onboarding cohorts, office hours, webinars, in\-product guidance, documentation, and templated success plans
* Develop our account health tracking methodology from the ground up — what signals matter, how they're weighted, how they trigger action, and how we know the scoring is predictive
* Partner cross\-functionally with RevOps, Marketing, and Engineering to build the infrastructure behind scaled CS: usage instrumentation, alerting, lifecycle triggers, and automated follow\-up
* Design the operational cadence for this segment: what regular communication looks like, how issues route to and from Product Support, and what escalation looks like. (Product Support owns ticket resolution. You own the process around it).
* Build reporting in Hex and with other AI tools that gives the business real visibility into Scaled segment health, adoption, and retention
* Translate portfolio\-wide patterns into prioritized input for Product

**Qualifications**

* 3–7 years in customer success, account management, CS operations, sales, or lifecycle/growth, including a high\-volume portfolio
* Experience building scaled or digital CS programs from scratch, or working as one of the first hires in a scaled CS role
* Technically fluent and self\-sufficient with data: product analytics and usage, pulling data with AI tools, and building tooling with AI
* Hands\-on with a modern GTM and support stack. Ours is Pylon, Hex, HubSpot, Salesforce, and Claude; we lean heavily on AI day to day and expect you to as well
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Series A/B/C or fast\-paced SaaS experience, with a proactive, ownership\-driven approach to ambiguity

**Nice to have**

* Experience defining or re\-segmenting a customer base, or standing up a support model for a new segment
* Background in customer marketing, growth, or RevOps
* Familiarity with research operations or market research


Compensation Range: $130K \- $180K

DELFI Diagnostics, Inc. (DELFI Diagnostics) is developing next\-generation, blood\-based tests that are reliable, accessible and deliver a new way to help detect cancer. Employing advanced machine\-learning methods to whole\-genome sequencing data, the DELFI ("DNA EvaLuation of Fragments for early Interception") platform is built to address the highest\-burden health challenges. DELFI Diagnostics prioritizes solutions that have the potential to save lives on a global scale, including for historically underserved populations. DELFI Diagnostics’ platform relies on fragmentomics – the discovery that cancer cells are more chaotic than normal cells and, when they die, leave behind tell\-tale patterns and characteristics of cell\-free DNA (cfDNA) fragments. FirstLook Lung, for individuals eligible for lung cancer screening, is DELFI Diagnostics’ first laboratory\-developed screening test and can be part of routine blood work. FirstLook Lung uses millions of data points to reliably identify individuals who may have cancer detected through low\-dose CT, including early stage disease with a negative predictive value of 99\.8 percent. This test has not been cleared or approved by the FDA.

The **Business Analyst** provides functional and analytical support for requirements validation, system design, financial activities, and program reporting. This role develops and updates project deliverables and system documentation, supports online and batch functionality, creates database queries and reports, and helps oversee a newly implemented payment plan program. **Key Responsibilities*** Gather, analyze, document, and validate business and functional requirements.

jobs.title: Client Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Nowadays**
==================


We're building the future of in\-person connection, from intimate exec offsites to a conference\-level company offsite.


Nowadays is the first AI\-powered platform for planning corporate events. Our software handles everything from venue sourcing to vendor negotiations, making it easier and faster for teams to meet up in real life.


We've planned events across the globe for companies like Google, Airbnb, and Quantstamp, and we're just getting started.


Our mission is simple: make it easier for teams to create meaningful moments together.

**Who we are**
==============


We're a sister\-founded team based in San Francisco. We move fast, care deeply, and love bringing people together (whether it's a strategic offsite or a Friendsgiving in our Nowadays home).


We believe the best teams:

* Take ownership
* Keep things scrappy
* Celebrate wins (big and small)
* Genuinely enjoy working (\+ hanging out) together


Some of our favorite team excursions so far:

* Flying trapeze
* Steak\-offs at home
* Hauling a Christmas tree up to the office
* Hitting the spa after a big launch
* Racing an Ironman Relay

**What this role is**
=====================


This is a **zero\-to\-one operations role**. You'll take messy, fast\-moving workflows and turn them into systems that are simple, teachable, and scalable, without losing the human care that defines Nowadays.

**What you'll do**
==================

**80% of your time will focus on event operations and client communication**

* Own events end\-to\-end simultaneously, including clear written \+ verbal on\-brand client communication
* Own and evolve the end\-to\-end ops flow for running events, from first request to post\-event wrap
* Be the point person for prioritizing urgent vs non\-urgent ops issues
* Turn tribal knowledge into clear documentation, onboarding, and templates that anyone can use

**The remaining 20% of your time will focus on building for scale**

* Build scalable playbooks for: running a single complex event start\-to\-finish, and managing many events in parallel
* Partner closely with engineering to: translate customer feedback and bugs into clear product requirements and actionable tickets, and help test, validate, and refine tools before launch
* Create and maintain internal resources: ops onboarding docs, and client\-facing guides and templates for planning offsites
* Continuously identify what should be simplified, automated, or eliminated

**What we're looking for**
==========================

* You consistently put clients first, understanding that this can sometimes require late nights or weekend work
* You can juggle multiple workstreams and know how to prioritize quickly
* You're excellent at turning complexity into clarity
* You care deeply about process, but never at the expense of momentum
* Extreme attention to detail
* You're comfortable working across ops, product, dev, sales, and clients
* You communicate clearly, thoughtfully, and with good judgment
* You like building systems that other people can run
* You want to shape how a company operates, not just follow a playbook

**Bonus points**
================

* Startup zero\-to\-one experience
* Experience working with clients \+ owning client relationships
* Strong intuition for customer experience and boundaries
* Experience writing clear tickets in tools like Linear or Jira
* Comfort with basic SQL or data analysis to answer operational questions
* Comfort using AI/tools to replace manual, repetitive work

**Other details**
=================

**Location**

* In\-person in San Francisco

**Perks**

* Free lunch \+ dinner
* Quarterly team offsites (yes, we went to the White Lotus S3 hotel in Thailand), and exclusive access to top venues and events
* Monthly fitness stipend
* Health insurance
* 12 weeks paid parental leave
* Generous PTO with required time off to recharge
* High ownership, autonomy, and direct access to founders
* Access to top venues, events, and travel experiences

  

Compensation Range: $90K \- $130K

jobs.title: Data Center Operations Manager (Site, Facility Operations)
jobs.description:
**Built to set the gold standard for integrated AI infrastructure**

  

Crux AI is a newly formed, U.S.\-based integrated AI infrastructure company created to remove the physical and operational constraints on consequential AI ambitions. Crux brings together power, high\-density data centers, TPU silicon, networking, orchestration software, and ongoing operations as one integrated system.

  

Crux is being capitalized to plan every layer together, develop each one to demanding standards, and operate the whole system with efficiency and reliability. That gives hyperscalers, frontier AI labs, sovereign customers, enterprises, and AI\-native companies greater freedom to pursue the AI they are here to create.

 **WHAT YOU'LL DO**


You will own critical facility operations for one Crux site or campus — the electrical, mechanical, fire/life\-safety, and controls infrastructure that keeps high\-density, liquid\-cooled TPU clusters continuously available. You will lead the 24/7 site facility team — chief engineer, shift technicians, and O\&M contractors — and run the maintenance, procedures, drills, and change control that produce uptime, whether the building is Crux\-owned or operated by a colocation partner you hold to SLA. In the early phase you will help bring the site to life: commissioning participation, acceptance, and the transition from construction to disciplined steady\-state operations.

**In this role, you will:**

* Establish and direct the site facility operations team — chief engineer, critical facility technicians, and contractors — with a 24/7 coverage model you design, staff, and train, maintaining highly available operations for all critical and non\-critical infrastructure.
* Operate and maintain the site’s electrical systems (utility interface through switchgear, generators, UPS, and distribution), mechanical plant (chilled water, direct\-to\-chip liquid cooling loops, CDUs, heat rejection), fire/life\-safety, and BMS/EPMS controls.
* Run the site maintenance program in CMMS — preventive, predictive, and corrective — with vendor and OEM service contracts managed to scope, and zero tolerance for overdue critical PMs.
* Enforce operating discipline: SOPs/MOPs/EOPs current and rehearsed, change management on every energized system, drill program run on schedule, and monthly self\-assessments presented to fleet leadership.
* Lead site incident response for facility events end to end — detection, stabilization, escalation, root cause, corrective action — including communication when customer workloads are at risk.
* On partner sites, manage the colocation operator to contracted SLAs: audit their maintenance records, witness their critical work, and enforce remedies when performance slips.
* Support site bring\-up: participate in commissioning through Level 5/IST, define and enforce ops acceptance criteria, tune the cooling plant to design intent in the first year, and manage warranty claims.
* Own the site facility budget, utility coordination, and efficiency performance (PUE, WUE, energy cost), and run a safety\-first culture (LOTO, energized work controls, working at height) with zero\-compromise standards.

**SIGNALS OF SUCCESS**

**After 60 days in this role:**

* Site staffing plan and 24/7 coverage model will be approved with hiring in motion.
* Ops acceptance criteria will be agreed upon with construction/commissioning.

**After 6 months:**

* CMMS is loaded with the site asset registry and PM schedules.
* Procedures library is drafted for every critical system (or partner program audited, on a colo site).

**After 1 year:**

* First site is operating with 24/7 coverage under the full standards library.
* Preventive maintenance program is live in CMMS with zero overdue critical PMs.
* Incident and change management program running.
* Colo partner SLA and audit program in force at partner sites.

**EXPERIENCES, ATTRIBUTES AND MINDSET THAT INDICATE A GOOD MATCH**

**Experiences**

* 10\+ years in critical facility or data center operations — including power generation, HVAC, or mission\-critical military/industrial environments — with 5\+ years managing technical teams and vendors operating, maintaining, and troubleshooting electrical, mechanical, and controls infrastructure in a 24/7 environment.
* Comprehensive working knowledge of electrical topologies (N\+1/2N, UPS, generators, switchgear), mechanical and liquid cooling systems, fire/life\-safety, and building automation — plus the safety programs (LOTO, hazardous energy control) that govern work on them.
* Site bring\-up or major expansion experience: commissioning participation, acceptance testing, and the construction\-to\-operations handoff on a mission\-critical facility.

**Attributes**

* *Owner of the building.* When the plant alarms at 2am it is yours until the site is stable and the root cause is written down. You are comfortable being the most senior Crux person on site and making the call under pressure.
* *Discipline without bureaucracy.* You run tight MOPs, drills, and change control because they prevent outages, and you kill process that does not — and you can tell the difference.

**Mindset**

* *High tolerance for ambiguity.* The site will energize before every procedure exists. You write the SOP, run it, fix it, and hand it to the next site rather than waiting for a standard to arrive.
* *AI\-agentic first.* Fluent with AI agents — or committed to becoming so quickly — and you embed them as first principles in how you and your team work, defaulting to agentic workflows before adding headcount or process.

**Nice to have (preferred, not required)**

* 7\+ years in Tier III/IV or hyperscale data center environments (Meta, Google, AWS, Microsoft, or a major colo operator).
* Direct\-to\-chip liquid cooling plant operations experience (CDUs, water chemistry, loop commissioning and tuning).
* Trade certifications (Electrical, HVAC, Controls), stationary engineer license, or military/nuclear power backgro

jobs.description:

------------------



Our Advertising \& Promotion team operates at the intersection of e\-commerce and advertising, building systems that surface and monetize relevant content for our core audiences. We develop digital solutions that help advertisers reach DoorDash customers while maintaining a high\-quality consumer experience.



As our ads business scales, we are investing in building foundational systems—from pricing and bidding to global platform consistency. Working closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Sales, this team defines how our ads platform operates today and scales into the future.


**About the Role**
------------------



This role sits at the center of our Ads \& Promotions platform, focused on building scalable monetization systems and driving high\-impact business outcomes. You will operate as a single\-threaded owner across critical initiatives, working cross\-functionally to define strategy, shape product direction, and drive execution.

* Define how our ads platform scales across global markets

* Own key business metrics and deliver against revenue, efficiency, and experience goals
* Drive initiatives end\-to\-end from problem definition through launch and iteration

* Partner cross\-functionally across Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Sales

* **Be an owner:** You will operate as a single\-threaded owner for critical monetization problems, defining strategy and driving execution end\-to\-end
* **Build systems:** You'll design scalable frameworks that power the ads business—not just one\-off solutions

jobs.title: Senior IT Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Pivot Point Solutions**
=========================



Pivot Point Solutions is a California\-based technology consulting firm that specializes in delivering IT solutions and support for the construction and utility industries. We partner with organizations across the state to provide reliable technology services that improve operational efficiency, enhance project delivery, and support critical business systems.



Our team understands the unique technology challenges facing construction and utility organizations, from field operations and infrastructure projects to enterprise applications and cybersecurity. By combining industry expertise with responsive service, we help clients modernize their technology environments, streamline workflows, and maintain secure, reliable IT systems that support long\-term growth.


**Job Overview**
----------------


**Title:** Senior IT Project Manager  

**Sector:** Information Technology / Privacy \& Compliance  

**Seniority:** Senior Level  

**Location:** Oakland, CA  

**Job Type:** Hybrid – Minimum 1 Day per Week Onsite, Additional Days Based on Business Needs  

**Contract Length:** 6 Months \+  

**Compensation:** $66\.45 \- $88\.09/hour


**Role Overview**
-----------------



Pivot Point Solutions is seeking an experienced Senior IT Project Manager to lead complex technology initiatives with an emphasis on Consumer Privacy and Cookie Compliance. This role will manage multiple concurrent projects and coordinate across IT, business, privacy, compliance, vendors, and other stakeholders to deliver initiatives within established scope, schedule, budget, and quality expectations.



The ideal candidate has 8\+ years of experience managing complex enterprise IT projects and direct experience delivering consumer privacy or cookie compliance initiatives. This position requires strong project governance, financial management, risk management, executive communication, and cross\-functional leadership skills in a structured enterprise environment.


**Your Day\-to\-Day Activities**
--------------------------------


* Lead one or more concurrent, complex IT projects from initiation through implementation and closeout.
* Manage consumer privacy and cookie compliance technology initiatives involving cross\-functional business, IT, privacy, compliance, and vendor teams.
* Define project requirements, objectives, scope, deliverables, timelines, resources, and success criteria.
* Develop and maintain detailed project schedules, work plans, milestones, dependencies, and delivery forecasts.
* Establish project teams and clearly communicate responsibilities, expectations, and accountability.
* Lead project kickoff meetings and ongoing stakeholder and project\-team discussions.
* Track and manage project risks, issues, decisions, dependencies, changes, and action items.
* Develop mitigation strategies and drive resolution of schedule, scope, resource, and delivery challenges.
* Manage project budgets and accurately forecast resource, material, vendor, and contract costs.
* Monitor project performance against established cost, schedule, scope, and quality objectives.
* Develop project metrics and reporting to provide visibility into progress, risks, and overall project health.
* Communicate project status, recommendations, risks, and escalations to sponsors, stakeholders, and management.
* Coordinate professional services, vendors, contracts, and project\-related procurement activities.
* Build productive working relationships with project sponsors, business partners, vendors, and technical teams.
* Lead project management analysts, schedulers, and other supporting project resources as needed.
* Mentor and provide project management guidance to developing team members.
* Maintain accurate project documentation throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Prepare project records and documentation for closure, retention, compliance, and potential audit activities.
* Support a structured PMO environment and follow established project management standards and methodologies.

**The Job Requirements**
------------------------


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 8\+ years of experience managing complex enterprise IT projects, software implementations, or technology delivery initiatives.
* Direct project management experience involving Consumer Privacy and/or Cookie Compliance initiatives.
* Active Project Management Professional (PMP) certification from PMI.
* Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent projects or complex cross\-functional initiatives.
* Experience managing project scope, schedule, budget, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, and change.
* Strong experience developing and maintaining detailed project schedules and work plans.
* Experience managing project budgets and developing cost and resource forecasts.
* Experience working with IT professional services agreements, vendors, contracts, and external resources.
* Strong understanding of enterprise IT organizations, roles, delivery processes, and governance.
* Experience leading teams within a matrixed organizational environment.
* Strong risk management, negotiation, problem\-solving, and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work across technical and non\-technical stakeholder groups.
* Ability to independently manage complex projects while providing direction to supporting project resources.
* Must be able to work onsite in Oakland at least one day per week, with additional onsite attendance based on business needs.

**You'll Stand Out If You Have**
--------------------------------


* Experience delivering enterprise consumer privacy programs involving cookie consent, tracking technologies, consent management, or digital privacy compliance.
* Experience supporting privacy initiatives involving CCPA/CPRA or other applicable consumer privacy requ

jobs.title: Technology Support Lead - Technical Implementation
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Lead a program organization to deliver measurable reliability and operational excellence outcomes across Payments Production Management.

**Job Description**


Embark on a transformative journey in technology risk and operational excellence at an iconic financial firm. You will help shape how critical services are delivered, improving reliability, transparency, and outcomes as we modernize how we run production. You will partner with engineering and operations leaders to turn complex initiatives into well\-governed programs that drive continuous improvement.


As a Technology Support Lead at JPMorganChase within Payments Production Management team, you will build the structures and operating rhythms that translate a broad portfolio of initiatives into a cohesive transformation roadmap. You will create clarity across diverse stakeholders, establish governance tied to outcomes, and drive disciplined execution that accelerates the evolution of Production Management into a mature Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) organization.

**Job responsibilities**

* Establish and lead a centralized program function to structure initiatives into clearly defined programs with scope, ownership, milestones, dependencies, and success metrics
* Recruit, develop, and mentor a high\-performing team of program leaders and managers to deliver programs end\-to\-end across the transformation portfolio
* Define scalable roles, standards, and ways of working across Payments Production Management
* Partner with Production Management and engineering leadership to shape a multi\-quarter transformation roadmap aligned to reliability maturity goals and business priorities
* Implement portfolio\-level governance, including intake, prioritization, sequencing, benefits tracking, and escalation to increase transparency and delivery confidence
* Consolidate fragmented efforts into coherent programs spanning reliability engineering practices, incident management maturity, observability, automation, toil reduction, capacity and performance, and release resilience
* Orchestrate cross\-functional execution across engineering, infrastructure, application teams, risk and control partners, product partners, and operations to remove blockers and accelerate delivery
* Track and improve reliability outcomes using agreed performance indicators such as availability, latency, incident frequency and severity, mean time to recovery, change failure rate, toil levels, and automation coverage
* Leads team adoption of enterprise\-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to improve incident triage speed and consistency (e.g., synthesizing operational signals into prioritized actions), with human\-in\-the\-loop validation and appropriate handling of sensitive data.
* Produce executive\-ready reporting and communications that connect work to outcomes, risks, decisions, and sustained adoption
* Applies reuse\-first, AI\-assisted practices across incident/problem/change routines to identify recurring interruption patterns and validate remediation actions aligned to resiliency and security expectations.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* 5\+ years of experience or equivalent expertise troubleshooting, resolving, and maintaining information technology services
* Demonstrated ability to build and scale a program management organization, including team formation, operating model design, governance, and execution discipline
* Proven program and portfolio leadership with strong delivery rigor, prioritization, and benefits tracking
* Strong systems\-thinking mindset and ability to drive continuous improvement through operational metrics and learning loops
* Strong understanding of IT service management and operational excellence, including incident management, problem management, observability, automation, toil reduction, reliability metrics, and service ownership
* Proven ability to create clarity out of ambiguity by structuring loosely defined initiatives into outcome\-oriented programs with measurable results
* Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills across senior leaders and technical teams in a matrixed environment
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including executive storytelling and concise status and risk reporting
* Demonstrated experience using enterprise\-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support production operations workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity.
* Ability to review and validate AI\-assisted incident recommendations before action, escalating when uncertain and ensuring outcomes align to operational, security, and auditability expectations.
* Bachelor's degree required

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Experience supporting enterprise\-scale payments or regulated financial services environments
* Familiarity with operational metrics frameworks such as service level indicators, service level objectives, and error budgets
* Experience partnering with risk, compliance, and control stakeholders to implement change in highly governed environments
* Experience driving agile\-at\-scale delivery and or Lean continuous improvement practices




This position is subject to Section 19 of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act. As such, an employment offer for this position is contingent on JPMorgan Chase's review of criminal conviction history, including pretrial diversions or program entries.


**ABOUT US**  

  

  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management

jobs.description:
**About Vantage**
=================

  

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well\-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.


**Position Description:**

**This role will be based in Santa Clara California, following our flexible work policy (3 days in\-office and 2 days flexible).**

* Vantage is looking for an Assistant Project Manager to assist the Special Projects team and Project Managers to drive success on new and ongoing construction projects.
* The position covers all aspects of a construction project. Areas of expertise that require minimal oversight and autonomy in the following areas:
* RFP development and overall project budgeting
* Pre\-bid oversight and coordination assistance
* Assist managing all design phases and documents
* Assist managing, coordinating and supervising design\-build contractors and vendors
* Assist and/or coordinate with internal stakeholders and subject matter experts
* Assist with oversight of physical construction activities
* Participation in commissioning
* Assist, manage and own project close outs: Punch list, as\-builds, warranties, OEM, etc.
**Essential Job Functions:**

* Report to and assist Vantage Special Projects team and assigned manager.
* Proficient at taking initiative, problem solving, time management, and thinking outside the box.
* Gather vendor proposals, invoicing documents and ensure vendor deliverables are delivered in a timely manner.
* Manage individual tasks throughout the construction process including submittals, RFI process, drawings and safety reporting.
* Proficient understanding of contract types; i.e., GMP, Lump Sum, NTE, etc.
* Proficient understanding of invoicing; i.e., lien waivers, pay applications, retention, etc.
* Proficient in leading OAC meetings, coordination meetings, and facilitating stakeholder meetings.
* Coordinate VDC led meetings, manage meeting minutes and drive actions to closure.
* Oversee OFCI equipment release, delivery, deficiencies, startup and commissioning.
* Ensure project compliance, track construction progress via daily logs, site inspections and QA/QC.
* Manage project close\-out and documentation.
 **Duties:**

* Manage small to medium sized projects with Special Projects Project Manager or Sr. Project Manager oversight.
* Occasionally, based on Assistant Project Manager’s experience, readiness and learning development; individual may be included in larger more technical projects to assist Special Projects Project Manager or Sr. Project Manager.
* Assist and or manage multiple projects concurrently and projects in various locations.
* Coordinate internal alignment on project document reviews, budgeting and financial exercises and purchase order management.
* Enforce project quality controls and safety programs through an in\-depth understanding of the partner contracts and design docs.
* Manage and provide weekly HRA inspections to adhere to VDC safety metrics.
* Perform tasks accurately and execute with minimal supervision.
* Assist Vantage PM(s) in preparing monthly financial updates and forecasts.
* Manage contractor billing to ensure accuracy of scope included in each billing and timely review of all pay applications.
* Manage change orders and review process independently. Provide timely review of change orders with accuracy of scope and costs.
* Input PO requests in the financial system, track and manage distribution process to all Vantage vendors.
* Facilitate design page\-turns, document reviews, meeting minutes, capture deliverables and action items for internal stakeholders and direct contractor design partners.
* Manage Vantage vendor partners to ensure completion of their scope and overall project completion (i.e., Signage, furniture, AV, etc.)
* As required, manage design team/contractors throughout each project.
* Work closely with VDC Ops to coordinate ongoing site activities, develop and track MOPs and provide customer support as necessary.
* Manage, organize and maintain internal file storage.
* Own internal and external project closeout requirements.
* Assist and track as\-builds, permits, and coordinate with local authorities to ensure permits and documents are current.
* Time to time, additional duties may be assigned by management.
 **Job Requirements:**

* Bachelor of Science in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, or a similar field, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum of 5\+ years’ experience as a Project Engineer in Construction Project Management assisting or supervising construction projects of increasing complexity is required.
* Data Center, Owner’s Representative and/or General Contractor experience is highly preferred.
* Experience in CSA (civil, structural, architectural) and MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) construction management is a requirement.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and project management tools like MS Project, P6, Procore and Bluebeam.
* Up to 10% travel may be required.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to handle or feel objects; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop or kneel; talk and hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

* Salary Range: $105,000 \- 115,000 Base \+ Bonus (this range is based on California market data and may vary

We are seeking a Project Coordinator to support the development and deployment of complex hardware tester systems used in manufacturing and validation environments. The role will coordinate multiple PCBAs, mechanical assemblies, cables, connectors, and system\-level components through the full hardware lifecycle, including material readiness, build planning, system integration, bring\-up, validation, and production readiness. jobs.title: Factory Program Manager
jobs.description:
Our client, a global financial services and digital payments company, is seeking a **Factory Program Manager.**


This position is an **on\-site, 6\-month contract.** You must be able to work in **San Jose, CA** and be eligible to work in the U.S without sponsorship. H\-1B visa holders are not eligible. Hourly rate: **$89\.19** \+ paid holidays through Talent Table. **No C2C**.

**Duties:**


As a Factory Program Manager for the Client's Proto Hardware team, you will serve as our primary onsite representative at Foxconn San Jose. You will coordinate daily factory activities, support new product introduction builds and engineering experiments, and drive Foxconn follow\-through on shared priorities and open issues.


You will bring structure and visibility to the work happening at the site. You will maintain the integrated schedule and issue list, coordinate onsite support, communicate weekly priorities, and escalate risks before they affect engineering or build schedules. This is a 6\-month contract position that requires working onsite at Foxconn San Jose five days per week.

**You Will:**

* Own the day\-to\-day coordination of activities at Foxconn San Jose, including new product introduction (NPI) builds, design of experiments (DOEs), testing, failure analysis, material deliveries, and facility work.
* Serve as the primary point of contact between the Client's Hardware Team and the Foxconn San Jose team.
* Maintain an integrated site schedule and master issue list, with clear owners, priorities, dependencies, and due dates.
* Establish a regular communication cadence that summarizes upcoming activities, required onsite support, progress, risks, and decisions.
* Drive Foxconn and cross\-functional teams to close open actions and escalate issues when progress is at risk.
* Coordinate shared resources, including technicians, lab equipment, test fixtures, floor space, and engineering support.
* Support build readiness by coordinating materials, equipment, documentation, staffing, and other requirements.
* Ensure results from experiments, testing, and failure analysis are documented and shared with the appropriate engineering teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve factory processes, site organization, and collaboration between the Client and Foxconn.
* Coordinate site infrastructure and workspace needs in partnership with Engineering, Operations, and IT.

 **Skills:**

**Company Description** **Specific information regarding this recruitment process is listed below.**

**Application Opening:** Wednesday, September 9, 2026  

**Application Deadline:** Apply immediately. Application filing will be open at least through 11:59pm (PST) of Wednesday, September 16, 2026, and will close any time thereafter.  

**Salary Range:** $228,124 \- $245,570 Annually ($109\.67 \- $118\.06 hourly)  

**Recruitment ID:** PEX\-5504\-164763; RTF0164762\-01121906

**Appointment Type:** Permanent\-Exempt (PEX), Category 18\. This position is excluded by the Charter from the competitive Civil Service examination process and shall serve at the discretion of the Appointing Officer and shall not exceed 36 months


Becoming a City employee means being a part of a team that cares about making a difference. Your work will shape both the present and future of San Francisco. When you work for the City, you’re choosing a job with purpose.


San Francisco Public Works (Public Works) has a far\-reaching portfolio with a $453 million annual operating budget, an active capital portfolio that exceeds $3 billion and a workforce of 1,700\-plus employees. The department operates around the clock, touching every neighborhood in San Francisco. The staff designs and manages the construction of civic buildings and streets; cleans and greens the right of way; maintains civic buildings; manages multi\-million\-dollar bond programs; trains people for jobs; keeps the right of way free of hazards; paves the roads; repairs bridges and public stairways; expands accessibility; and works at the forefront addressing some of San Francisco’s biggest challenges. With a mission to enhance the quality of life in San Francisco for residents, visitors and business owners, Public Works is committed to providing outstanding public service through an equity lens.


Please visit the “About Us” section of our website at https://www.sfpublicworks.org to learn more about the department’s core values, Racial Equity Initiative, leadership team, history, budget and more.


Public Works currently has 2 vacancies for a Project Manager II (5504\) within the Project Delivery Division.

 **Job Description** **Role Description:**


The San Francisco Public Works streetscape portfolio encompasses a number of major projects including the Bayview Multimodal Improvement Projects, the 11th Street Safety Project and other projects totaling over $121 million, with active planning, design, construction, or financial closeout phases extending through 2030\. These projects involve transforming high\-volume corridors through multi\-modal safety enhancements, protected bike lanes, and extensive utility and public realm upgrades while coordinating closely with merchants and local community benefit districts to mitigate event impacts. These projects involve working with design elements that involve deep partnership with community leaders and cultural stakeholders. Together, these citywide efforts backed by interagency collaboration with partners such as the SFMTA, San Francisco Planning, and the SFPUC aim to modernize San Francisco's corridors, elevate pedestrian safety, and celebrate neighborhood identity.

**Important and Essential Duties include, but are not limited to:**

* Directing and overseeing a portfolio of major streetscape, transit, and public realm capital projects through active phases of planning, design, construction, and financial closeout.
* Providing technical oversight, performance guidance, and mentorship to subordinate project managers overseeing portfolios valued at up to $66 million.
* Coordinating the implementation of large\-scale multi\-modal safety enhancements, roadway reconstructions, utility and sewer upgrades, traffic signals, green infrastructure, and public realm improvements.
* Engaging with neighborhood organizations, stakeholders, and business districts to preserve historical character\-defining features and address community concerns during project execution.
* Coordinating complex construction sequencing around major public venues, commercial activities, and high\-traffic events to minimize disruption to the community.
* Leading interagency and cross\-departmental collaboration by partnering with municipal planning, transportation, utilities, arts, and recreation agencies to secure approvals, align public realm plans, and ensure cohesive design standards across the city.

  

**Qualifications** **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**


1\. a) Bachelor's Degree in architecture, engineering or planning; **and**  

 b) Four (4\) years of responsible professional experience in architectural, engineering or construction management experience; **and**  

 c) Two (2\) years of additional project coordination experience;

**OR**


2\. a) Bachelor's Degree in another field; **and**  

 b) Six (6\) years of responsible professional experience in a field directly related to the project; **and**  

 c) Two (2\) years of additional project coordination experience;  

  

**OR**


3\. a) Eight (8\) years of architectural, engineering, or construction management experience in a field directly related to the project; **and**  

 b) Two (2\) years of additional project coordination experience;  

  

**OR**


4\. a) California registration as professional engineer or architect; **and**  

 b) Two (2\) years of additional project coordination experience

**Note:**  

One (1\) year of full\-time employment is considered equivalent to Two Thousand (2,000\) hours. Any overtime hours that you work above forty (40\) hours per week are not included in the calculation to determine full\-time employment.

**Verification:**  

Applicants may be required to submit verification of qualifying education and experience at any point during the recruitment and selection process. More information can be found at: https://sfdhr.org/recruitment\-details\#verification.

jobs.title: Senior Web Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Who we are**



Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.



Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video\-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

**About the role:**



Our Senior Web Program Manager is a strategic role responsible for overseeing multiple interconnected web projects and driving complex digital initiatives that align with organizational objectives. It combines advanced program management expertise with strategic thinking, stakeholder management, and team leadership to deliver high\-impact programs — bringing structure, streamlined processes, and best practices to our digital organization.



The ideal candidate has previous experience working in a digital agency and/or internal digital department where high\-quality results are required.



This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US, with working hours in the Pacific time zone and the ability to collaborate with colleagues across a variety of time zones.


**You Should Apply If:**


* You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real\-world impact — helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
* You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper\-growth environment.
* You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
* You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high\-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

**In this role, you will:**


*Program \& Project Management*


* Own all phases of complex, cross\-functional digital programs — from inbound ticket management, to planning through delivery — with a clear understanding of vision, scope, objectives, timelines, business value, and resource requirements.
* Develop holistic program plans comprised of multiple project plan documents, including business requirements, technical specifications, schedules, funding, and resource plans.
* Track milestones, tasks, and deliverables; provide timely status updates to stakeholders and senior executives; and proactively identify and mitigate risks and dependencies.
* Lead process improvement initiatives to increase efficiency and delivery quality.

*Stakeholder \& Executive Communication*


* Serve as the strategic bridge between vision and tactical execution, translating high\-level business objectives into actionable program roadmaps.
* Interface with executives and senior leadership to align on priorities, communicate timelines and approval frameworks, and present program progress and website demonstrations.
* Facilitate team discussions, resolve conflict, and remove impediments that block the team's ability to meet project objectives.

*Cross\-Functional Collaboration*


* Orchestrate the efforts of cross\-functional teams — including Creative, IT, PMM, Campaigns, and front\-end development — to execute strategic launches, awareness campaigns, website updates, and other digital initiatives.
* Partner with internal stakeholders to define desired website functionality and appearance; lead the development team through product development stages and into live deployment.
* Work effectively with external agency providers, consultants, and contractors as needed.

*Process \& Documentation*


* Document website development processes and procedures; establish and scale best practices across the digital program.
* Introduce mitigation tactics to minimize project delivery risks and drive continuous improvement across programs.

**Minimum Requirements**


* 7\+ years of project management experience at a digital agency and/or internal digital department with a primary focus on digital
* Proficiency with project management tools and methodologies (e.g., Airtable, Jira, Google Sheets) and experience with Google Suite, Salesforce, and Tableau
* Experience integrating AI tools into program management processes to increase efficiency
* Strong understanding of the digital production process, timelines, and scoping requirements
* Experience launching digital solutions, including ongoing analysis and continuous product improvements
* Working knowledge of the technical software development process and Agile delivery methods, including Scrum and/or Kanban
* Outstanding organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills — written, verbal, and presentation
* Ability to work effectively with agency providers, consultants, contractors, and other external suppliers
* Proactive approach to identifying and resolving obstacles and risks in partnership with teams and stakeholders

**Total Rewards**

jobs.title: Associate Project Manager, Permitting [California]
jobs.description:
**About Pulley**


Pulley helps the country’s top architects, builders, and retailers speed up every project in their portfolio. With AI\-powered permitting intelligence and expert guidance, we eliminate costly delays and bring predictability across the full lifecycle of commercial projects.


Today, permitting is the slowest, most uncertain part of building, spread across 19,000\+ jurisdictions with different rules, timelines, and surprises. Pulley gives project teams the clarity and predictability they need to move from planning to opening without delays.


We support rollout programs for brands like J.Crew, Solidcore, and Hibbett Sports, as well as major data center buildouts, EV charging networks, and other commercial projects. Our platform dramatically reduces approval timelines, improves forecasting accuracy, and removes thousands of hours of manual work from design and construction teams.


Founded in 2021, Pulley combines deep permitting expertise with purpose\-built AI from people who have created products used by millions. We’re backed by CRV, Susa Ventures, Fifth Wall, and leaders from Plaid, Segment, ServiceTitan, and Procore.

 **The Role**

***You must be located in*** ***California*** ***to be considered for this role.***

Our in\-house permitting team is a key function for driving fast, reliable permitting outcomes for our customers. In this role, you will:

* Support our lead project managers in delivering great permitting outcomes for customers
* Help conduct permit research with a high degree of accuracy
* Assist in preparing permit plans
* Collaborate with city staff on nuances and ambiguities
* Monitor permit status and ensure timely responses
* Provide feedback to product \& engineering teams to help refine our software platform

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of technical infrastructure program managers, software engineers, data specialists, supply chain specialists, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for planning and execution while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) designs, delivers, and operates the global data\-center fleet that powers every AWS service. Our servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling assets in more than 245 countries and territories. We tackle some of the world’s most complex supply\-chain problems so our customers can innovate without limits.  

  

In this team you will own core functions that drive planning automation and optimization for the 0\-2 year planning horizon for AWS's rapidly growing AI/ML server footprint. You will partner with cross functional teams to deeply understand requirements for servers (power, materials, manufacturing capacity, etc.) and build forward looking plans on what we can deliver and when. Due to the quickly evolving nature of this business, requirements and designs change quickly and often involve long lead time inputs. You will partner with our tech teams to build systems that automate and optimize our planning strategies to enable scaling. Success requires exceptional judgment, a builder’s mindset, and the ability to influence at all levels—from front\-line planners to VP\- and SVP\-level business owners.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Own the global S\&OP cycle – Drive an end\-to\-end, weekly/monthly/quarterly cadence that aligns AWS demand signals with supply, power, and capital plans.

  

* Deliver a trusted signal – Produce a single source of truth that reconciles financial plans, sales \& growth outlooks, NPI roadmaps, transition ramps, and prior POR commitments.

  

* Run executive planning forums – Frame one\-way vs. two\-way\-door decisions, articulate trade\-offs, and secure leadership alignment across AIS, EC2, S3, EBS, Finance, and Energy.

  

* Architect planning systems – Guide software teams in automating demand\-, supply\-, and scenario\-planning workflows (e.g., Connect, o9, Infor, Manhattan); own interim manual mechanisms until automation is in place.

  

* Build decision frameworks – Develop constrained\-planning models that surface risks and levers under power, permitting, or component shortages.

  

* Measure what matters – Define KPIs and dashboards that quantify forecast accuracy, inventory turns, build\-plan adherence, and capacity\-delivery cycle time.

  

* Champion continuous improvement – Sponsor digital\-transformation sprints that simplify processes, eliminate waste, and raise planning maturity across AIS.

  

About the team  

About AWS  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and Diversity conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

jobs.description:
Description:
**Title:** Program Manager  

**Organization:** Boys and Girls Clubs of San Leandro  

**Location:** School\-based Site  

**Department:** Programming

**Reports to:** Area Director

**Direct Reports:** Site Operations \& Safety Coordinator, KinderCare Coordinators, \& Youth Development Professionals  

**Exempt Status:** Exempt

**Position Type:** Full\-Time, On\-Site

**Compensation:** $70,000 \- $84,000

**Position Overview:**


The Program Manager leads high\-quality after\-school programming that empowers youth, supports families, and aligns with A.S.E.S. and ELOP standards. This role oversees program operations, staff supervision, and partnerships with schools and community organizations to create a safe, engaging, and outcome\-driven environment.


Responsible for staff development, program evaluation, and resource management, the Program Manager ensures that youth receive enriching experiences that prepare them for success. By fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and strong community engagement, this role plays a key part in advancing BGCSL’s mission to inspire and empower all young people to reach their full potential.

**Our Values in Action:**

**Transformative Leadership:** We aspire to transform possibilities into probabilities. By embodying emotional intelligence, vulnerability, and empathy, we foster positive change with humility, authenticity, and continuous self\-improvement.

* ***What that looks like in this role:***Leading with empathy, self\-awareness, and a commitment to continuous growth, creating an environment where staff feel supported, empowered, and confident in their roles. Encouraging a culture of learning, collaboration, and adaptability while investing in staff development to cultivate future leaders. Ensuring alignment with organizational values by guiding youth enrichment programming, child supervision, and family engagement. Providing clear direction, feedback, and support to staff, reinforcing high standards for program quality and professionalism.

**Resilience:** We approach every situation with a growth mindset, demonstrating flexibility and courage, reframing challenges as opportunities. We acknowledge our current state, embrace change, and adapt as needed, maintaining a solutions\-oriented approach throughout our growth journey.

* ***What that looks like in this role:***Navigating daily challenges such as staffing changes, behavior management, and program logistics with flexibility and a solutions\-focused mindset. Modeling perseverance and adaptability for both staff and students, ensuring program goals remain the priority despite obstacles. Creating a structured yet responsive environment where challenges become opportunities for learning and growth. Maintaining a focus on continuous improvement, using data, feedback, and site observations to enhance program effectiveness.

**Youth Centered Approach:** Every organizational action or maneuver is designed to directly impact and benefit the youth we serve. We value and prioritize the youth perspective, making decisions with a focus on their needs and well\-being, rather than adult convenience.

* ***What that looks like in this role:*** Prioritizing student well\-being and success by ensuring that curriculum, enrichment activities, and behavior support strategies are designed to meet the diverse needs of youth. Fostering a safe, structured, and engaging after\-school environment that bridges the gap between school, home, and community. Actively incorporating student voices into programming, creating a space where all young people feel valued, seen, and empowered. Building strong relationships with school staff, parents, and community partners to align site culture and resources in support of youth development.

**Essential Functions:**

* **Leadership \& Program Oversight**: Manage after\-school site programs, activities, and services to prepare youth for success while ensuring compliance with A.S.E.S./ELOP standards and maintaining a safe, outcome\-driven environment.
* **Staff Supervision \& Development**: Provide leadership to the Kinder Care Coordinator and Youth Development Professionals (YDPs), guiding child supervision, youth enrichment programming, and parent engagement while reinforcing organizational values.
* **Training \& Professional Growth**: Participate in and occasionally plan meetings, trainings, and organizational events, ensuring staff development and adherence to best practices in after\-school programming.
* **Program Evaluation \& Continuous Improvement**: Utilize CRM (MyClubHub) data, compile monthly reports, and conduct site observations to assess program effectiveness and recommend improvements in collaboration with key stakeholders.
* **Accountability \& Performance Management**: Supervise staff, ensure adherence to program goals and objectives, administer corrective action when necessary, and partner with HR and leadership to address staff or member\-related issues.
