jobs.title: Senior Product Quality Manager
jobs.description:
Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award\-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.


Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.


We are seeking a Senior Product Quality Manager to join our Supply Chain team in San Francisco, California. This role sits at the intersection of Oura Manufacturing, R\&D, and Supply Chain, partnering closely with design, process engineering, operations, and contract manufacturers (CMs) to drive the successful development and ramp of New Product Introduction (NPI) programs.


You will champion product quality and the user experience by ensuring every ring meets Oura’s rigorous standards for health accuracy, reliability, and jewelry\-like craftsmanship. You will establish and improve quality systems at CMs, ensuring robust data collection and analysis to support critical program decisions and long\-term supply chain improvements.


From concept through high\-volume production, you will develop and implement measurement methods, control plans, and quality processes that ensure components and assemblies are manufacturable, scalable, and consistently meet product requirements. You will serve as a key liaison between Oura and our manufacturing partners, fostering a strong culture of quality across the supply chain.


Working closely with Operations and Program Management, you will plan and execute NPI builds while continuously influencing both product and process development. Success in this role requires a strong understanding of manufacturing processes, Design for Manufacturing (DFM), and the ability to translate quality requirements into scalable manufacturing solutions.


**This is a US Hybrid role based in the San Francisco Bay Area, with an in\-office requirement of three days per week, and will require significant travel to Finland and Asia.**


### **What You Will Do:**


* Support New Product Introduction (NPI) through FATP development builds, ramp\-up, and product launch / mass production
* Serve as the bridge between Design, Engineering, and Operations, translating complex technical risks into actionable business decisions to drive Oura’s quality initiatives
* Analyze build failure data to identify design and process marginalities, ensuring that yield loss is understood from a quality risk perspective, not just a volume perspective
* Lead build readiness reviews, focusing on quality deliverables such as equipment readiness, process qualification, and post\-build quality data analysis to understand system level interactions and assembly tolerance stackups that drive design and process improvements
* Establish and enforce the standard for “premium” quality by defining cosmetic specifications, managing golden/limit samples, and aligning design, engineering, and factory teams on subjective criteria (fit, finish, and feel) early in the NPI process.
* Identify and effectively communicate design and process risks, using data\-driven approaches to facilitate discussions and improvements across Oura teams and suppliers
* Analyze and evaluate data to establish appropriate sub\-assembly / system level spec limits including cosmetic, dimensional, functional/reliability as well as establish process controls limits
* Validate that CM processes produce units that meet cosmetic, reliability, and functional design intent.
* You are a technical leader who refuses to compromise on the user experience. You understand that “shippable” isn't just about passing a functional test, but about meeting the high aesthetic and reliability standards our customers expect.

### **What you'll bring**


* 7\+ years of experience working in a Product Quality, Supplier Manufacturing, Manufacturing Quality Engineer, or Process Engineer role. Ideally seeking someone with strong mechanical process development and design understanding
* Experience in System Integration environments (FATP), bringing together mechanical enclosures and electronics into a final finished product.
* Experience with quality engineering in high volume hand held / wearable and/or consumer products manufacturing with high cosmetic standards
* Experience qualifying and auditing manufacturing processes including PSA/HAF attach, epoxy dispense/molding/curing, and solder/hotbar/laser weld
* Experience developing robust IQC / IPQC / OQC controls, including AOI \& cosmetics, sampling plans, qualification criteria, SOP/MSOP, CQA, OBA, and dimensional control
* Understanding of quality principles and tools such as GRR, CRR, SPC, FA/CA, FMEA, and DOEs.
* Understanding of manufacturing/design principles and tools such as DFM, GD\&T, and Six Sigma methodologies for variability reduction
* A self\-driven mindset, and are an eager problem solver who thrives in demanding quick\-paced environments
* High organizational skills with the ability to clearly and succinctly communicate complex concepts through presentations and written communication, such as slide decks and email
* Ability to set up systems to capture reliable and meaningful data to help drive critical process improvements and enhance product/component design
* Willingness and eagerness to travel internationally up to 50%

### **Benefits**


At Ōura, we care about you and your well\-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.


What we offer:


* Competitive salary and equity packages
* Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources
* An Ōura Ring of your own

jobs.title: Supply Chain Program Manager
jobs.description:
***The Company***


Halo Industries has developed breakthrough technology to revolutionize a decades\-old semiconductor material slicing process. Our laser\-based solution minimizes waste, enhances material cost efficiency, and drives innovations across high\-growth markets, including automotive, telecommunications, and power electronics. Founded in 2014 at Stanford University, Halo received significant funding in 2024, paving the way for rapid expansion, strategic customer engagement, and the launch of volume manufacturing.

***The Opportunity***


We are seeking a highly strategic and technical Commodity Business Manager to join our supply chain team. In this role, you will be responsible for sourcing and managing both the highly specialized raw materials required for our wafers and the critical electromechanical components needed to build our proprietary manufacturing equipment.


You will also develop comprehensive sourcing strategies, manage robust supplier relationships, drive cost and quality improvements, and lead complex procurement processes.

***Key Responsibilities***


Strategic Sourcing \& Category Management

* Develop and Execute Commodity Strategies: Create comprehensive, multi\-year sourcing strategies for raw materials and capital equipment sub\-components.
* Market Intelligence: Continuously monitor global market conditions, raw material indices, and geopolitical factors impacting the semiconductor and supply chains. Conduct deep market research and analysis to identify technological trends, evaluate supplier capabilities, and proactively identify potential global risks within assigned commodity categories
* Dual\-Sourcing Initiatives: Identify, qualify, and onboard primary and secondary suppliers to mitigate risk and eliminate single points of failure in the supply chain.


Supplier Relationship Management

* Contract Negotiation: Lead complex negotiations for Master Supply Agreements, Statements of Work, and pricing contracts.
* Performance Monitoring: Conduct regular Quarterly Business Reviews with key suppliers to evaluate performance against rigorous Quality, Cost, Delivery, and Innovation metrics.
* Capacity Planning: Work closely with suppliers to ensure their manufacturing capacity aligns with our long\-term production forecasts and equipment build schedules.
* Supplier Relations: Research, select, and manage strategic suppliers; conduct performance reviews, monitor KPIs (quality, delivery), and negotiate contracts.


Cross\-Functional Leadership

* New Product Introduction: Partner with R\&D and the NPI Team during the design phase of new tools to ensure Design for Manufacturability and supply chain viability.
* Cost Reduction: Collaborate with engineering and manufacturing to identify Value Analysis/Value Engineering opportunities, thereby driving down the Bill of Materials cost
* Escalation Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for critical supply shortages, leading cross\-functional task forces to resolve bottlenecks and prevent production downtime.
* Program Management: Collaborate daily with Supply Chain, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, NPI, and Finance teams to align commodity strategies with overall business objectives, production schedules, and product design phases. Participate in corporate continuous improvement initiatives to enhance end\-to\-end supply chain processes, reduce lifecycle costs, and mitigate risks.

  

**Requirements** **Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering (Mechanical, Materials Science, or Electrical), Business, or a related field.
* 8\+ years of experience in strategic sourcing, commodity management, or supply chain within the semiconductor, capital equipment, or advanced materials industries.
* Proficiency reading engineering drawings and understand complex technical specifications related to both raw materials (purity levels, material properties) and equipment components (tolerances, vacuum standards).
* Experience performing complex cost modeling, Should\-Cost analysis, and Total Cost of Ownership evaluations.
* Experience utilizing ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite) and PLM software (e.g., Arena).
* Direct experience in the semiconductor or related high\-tech industries.
* Direct experience supporting New Product Introductions (NPI), including supplier selection and qualification for engineering prototypes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced negotiation skills with a history of executing favorable long\-term contracts in volatile markets.
* Experience developing and executing successful, long\-term global commodity sourcing strategies for specialized materials or capital equipment components.
* Familiarity with global supply chain management complexity, geopolitical factors, and risk mitigation planning.
* Experience with the complexities of compliance driven procurement for automotive or IATF 16949\.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.

**Other Requirements**

* This is a full\-time role primarily based onsite at our Santa Clara, CA office.
* Some domestic and international travel may be required (up to 10%).

 **Benefits**  

* Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision)
* Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
* Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick \& Public Holidays)
* Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary \& AD\&D)
* Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
* Free Food \& Snacks
* Stock Option Plan
* Annual Bonus Plan eligible
* Short Term \& Long Term Disability
* Base Salary: $140,000 \- $160,000

*Additional Information*


We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all team members feel valued and supported. We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, including those from underrepresented communities in STEM. If you meet most of the qualifications and are excited about this opportunity, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Environmental Program Manager, AWS Environmental Team
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


You’ll join a diverse team within our new manufacturing division for AWS supporting hardware, software, network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, plant managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards of production for our datacenters and our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

As an Environmental Program Manager, you will be responsible for environmental compliance at AWS manufacturing facilities in the Central AMER region. You will assist in facility permitting and development, develop standards and policies to support regulatory compliance, complete environmental performance analysis, establish and monitor metrics, and guide the teams in implementation of Amazon environmental programs. You will provide guidance and build effective relationships with internal and external partners, including government entities, contractors, consultants, design, construction, operations and other key stakeholders.  

  

This position is based in Florence, Ky  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Performing due diligence and permitting for new manufacturing faculties.
* Develop new compliance programs for first of a kind operational processes.
* Manage and oversee compliance with environmental regulations and Amazon policy;
* Drive an environmentally responsible culture within the organization;
* Ensure work performed by contractors, consultants, and employees is completed in accordance with Amazon standards;
* Develop environmental metrics to measure, monitor and forecast performance;
* Conduct thorough and accurate environmental audits for continuous improvement;
* Prioritize and manage multiple technically complex assignments concurrently;
* Represent Amazon at appropriate levels with governmental agencies and throughout the company;
* Build collaborative relationships with various stakeholders to ensure risks are identified early and managed appropriately;
* Assist in time\-critical report submission to various governmental agencies;
* Complete thorough and accurate environmental incident investigations and associated regulatory reports and develop appropriate corrective action.

  

About the team  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security within our manufacturing process. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.  

  

  

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of technical infrastructure management experience
* Knowledge of best practices and emerging technologies, related to infrastructure (i.e. network, data center, hardware, software)
* Experience with varying scenarios of infrastructure builds
* BA/BS degree in biology, environmental science, chemistry, chemical or environmental engineering, or related field of study
* Broad knowledge of US environmental regulations
* 5\+ years of environmental, regulatory and risk management experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with due diligence and permitting for manufacturing faculties
* Experience successfully implementing environmental systems and compliance programs in a manufacturing settings

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

jobs.title: Clinical Safety Program Lead
jobs.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life\-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

**Working at Abbott**


At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

* Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
* Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
* An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution
* Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit \- an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
* A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
* A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

**The Opportunity**

The Clinical Safety Program Lead combines clinical study leadership, project management, and medical safety oversight to drive the successful execution of global clinical investigations. Serving as both the operational portfolio lead and study\-level safety expert, this role partners closely with Safety leadership and ensures studies are delivered efficiently while maintaining the highest standards of subject safety, scientific integrity, data quality, and regulatory compliance across the assigned portfolio. The individual is responsible for driving operational decisions, identifying gaps, developing solutions, and leading end\-to\-end data quality and safety processes. This individual anticipates and mitigates risks, proactively escalates and resolves issues, and drives execution against critical timelines in partnership with cross\-functional stakeholders. jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

------------


The Intuit Customer Success (ICS) Data Science \& Analytics team is seeking an exceptional Manager 2, Data Science to lead measurement of expert\-driven service excellence across our CG expert workforce. You will lead a team of data scientists covering five interlocking areas: expert\-driven conversion initiatives, VEP operational capabilities (work item management, scheduling, and appointments), training efficacy and expert upskilling strategy, expert quality and service\-guidance adherence, and labor optimization across our Team of Experts.

  

Collaborating closely with VEP (Virtual Expert Platform), Expert Network, and Service Design leaders, you will build the measurement backbone needed to see and optimize service excellence end\-to\-end (E2E) at scale for CG — with a particular focus on conversion and customer\-serving time outcomes. Your contributions will be instrumental in shaping the future of customer success at Intuit as we build a service platform to empower our customers beyond core product use. This is your opportunity to join this exciting and transformational journey.

 **Responsibilities**

* Own the measurement strategy across CG's expert service pillars — expert experiences conversion initiatives, VEP operational capabilities, training and upskilling, expert quality and service\-guidance adherence, and labor optimization — in close partnership with VEP, Expert Network, and Service Design leaders.
* Advance causal inference and experimentation as a shared capability, establishing the causal relationship between service guidance, expert behavior, and outcomes like conversion and customer\-serving time.
* Contribute to a cross\-signal, causal\-graph decision engine that connects expert behavior, quality, and operational signals to size the impact of levers and inform roadmap and investment decisions.
* Build and govern the training and learning platform efficacy framework, connecting L\&D investment to expert quality and business outcomes.
* Partner with cross\-functional business leaders (e.g., VEP, Expert Network, Service Design, Service Delivery, Operations, Learning \& Development, Expert Engagement) to shape strategy, investment priorities, and reporting cadence (e.g., WBR, Redzone).
* Lead and develop a world\-class team of analysts and data scientists, coaching technical and strategic skill sets, especially in advanced analytics, applied data science, and modeling.
* Translate business and analytics strategies into multiple short\-term and long\-term projects, and manage end\-to\-end execution, including the creation of a metric framework for expert experiences and developing learning plans that connect training and service investments to expert experience metrics.
* Activate analytics insights that lead to decisions or better hypotheses, and evangelize innovative analytics ideas that enable new opportunities.
* Drive analytics rigor by inspecting and improving experimentation methodologies and techniques, and creating a learning culture.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). The candidate will have a key a role in development, implementation, and maintenance of a quality system for all Drug Safety activities, encompassing processes, procedures, compliance, and metrics.

* Assists in overseeing the CRO processing SAE reports on Cytokinetics products in accordance with all applicable regulations, guidelines, and SOPs. This includes detailed review of source documentation, assessing cases for reportability, generation of analysis of similar events, quality check.
* Processes adverse event related information in drug safety database for Cytokinetics’ products, including the writing of narratives for expedited and non\-expedited reports.
* Coordinates follow up for missing or ambiguous safety data.

jobs.description:
**About Ramp**
==============


Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000\+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.


The problems are high\-stakes, data\-dense, and unforgiving.


We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.


The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.


If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

**About the Role**
==================


Ramp builds software that moves real money, from bill payments and corporate cards to reimbursements, accounting integrations, and travel. Our customers rely on us to keep their operations running: invoices get paid, books get closed, and finance leaders can trust the data behind every decision.


In this role, you will be the person who spots where customers are getting stuck and drives issues to a clear resolution. You will learn a complex product deeply enough to troubleshoot across payments, bank linking, accounting syncs, and card programs, then partner with teams across Engineering, Risk, Product, and Partnerships to get problems solved. This is not script\-based support. You will triage, investigate, and make high\-signal judgment calls throughout the day.


You will thrive in this role if you are a systems thinker and deeply customer obsessed. Support is the baseline. How you think about improving processes, tools, and outcomes is what sets you apart.

  

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Be the voice of Ramp's Customer Support.** You'll spend your day engaging with customers, primarily via live calls, email, and chat.
* **Diagnose across a broad product surface.** Ramp isn't one product — it's payments, cards, travel, accounting integrations, and more. You'll need to understand how they connect and where they break.
* **Operate with an ownership mindset, managing escalations end\-to\-end.** You take full accountability for every ticket you handle. When an issue crosses team boundaries — risk, engineering, product, partnerships — you route it correctly, follow up, and make sure the customer isn't left waiting. You'll work across Zendesk, internal tooling, and Slack\-based escalation workflows.
* **Build and shape AI tools, not just use them.** Ramp is building AI into CX operations. You'll use AI\-powered research tools and proprietary tools like Glass daily, provide direct feedback on what's working, and play an active role in how these tools evolve. You're not just a user — you're a builder. We are all builders at Ramp.
* **Ship improvements, not just flag them.** When you notice a process gap, a missing SOP, or a knowledge base article that's sending associates down the wrong path, you don't just raise it — you have the autonomy to roll up your sleeves and fix it. Leverage AI to solve problems, build automations, and improve the systems around you. The best people in this role make the whole team better.
* **Communicate with precision and empathy.** Our customers are financially sophisticated. You need to explain what's happening, what you're doing about it, and what they should expect — clearly and without filler.

**What You Need**
-----------------

* You're a systems thinker: you don't just solve the ticket in front of you, you ask why the problem exists and how to prevent it from happening again.
* You actively use AI tools — Claude, Notion AI, research and workflow tools — and can demonstrate how you've applied them to get real work done. This is a hard requirement.
* You're fast\-moving while holding yourself to a high bar for execution: you balance speed, accuracy, and thoroughness in every interaction.
* You can hold a technical conversation about how systems connect (APIs, bank integrations, accounting software) even if you're not writing code.
* You manage competing priorities without dropping things. When you have 15 open issues across 4 internal teams, nothing falls through.
* You write clearly and concisely. You can explain a payment reconciliation issue to a CFO without jargon.
* You're comfortable on the phone. Many interactions start there.
* You have a demonstrated track record of exceeding key performance standards, including CSAT, QA, and speed\-of\-service metrics.

**Nice to Haves**
-----------------

* Experience building workflows or automations using AI tools, not just prompting
* Familiarity with accounting workflows (AP/AR, GL, reconciliation) or ERP integrations (NetSuite, QuickBooks, Sage)
* Background in payments infrastructure (ACH, wire transfers, card networks)
* Track record of working somewhere that shipped product fast and expected CX to keep up

**Why be a CX Associate at Ramp**
---------------------------------

* **Cross\-functional exposure from day one.** You work directly with Product, Engineering, and GTM teams — not siloed into a support queue.
* **AI tools and unlimited access.** Unlimited tokens, proprietary AI tools like Glass, and a culture that expects you to use them to move faster and build smarter.
* **Career growth that you own.** Grow within CX, explore other functions internally, or carve out a path that doesn't exist yet. If you're invested, we're invested.
* **Culture that's different from a call center.** Team events, in\-person offsites, and a genuine commitment to building a team people want to be part of.

Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

  

**Attributes We Value**
-----------------------


We hire successful builders with founder\-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role\-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.


You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end\-to\-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

  

**About the team**


The Operations team at Airwallex ensures the smooth and efficient functioning of our services and processes. We focus on optimizing workflows, improving operational efficiency, and delivering exceptional customer support. By streamlining operations and implementing best practices, we help drive the company's growth and maintain high service standards. Our team is dedicated to providing a seamless experience for our customers and supporting Airwallex's mission to empower businesses globally.


**What you'll do**


You will join the Client Enablement (CE) team, working to build a seamless customer product onboarding and configuration experience for Airwallex customers across the US and globally. In this role, you will work with various internal stakeholders to ensure client accounts are ready for transaction and that client transactions can be processed smoothly in production environments. You will partner closely with Commercial, Solution Engineering, and Product teams to configure pricing and account capabilities, while identifying opportunities to improve the onboarding experience at scale. The CE team is small but business critical, and you will play a key role in providing a positive initial experience with the platform as the US business continues to grow.


This hybrid role is based in San Francisco, CA.


**Responsibilities:**


* Be a key source of knowledge on Airwallex configuration topics across product domains for both pricing and capability configuration details.
* Work with account executives to amend Airwallex account pricing per the commercial team's request.
* Co\-work with solution engineers globally to gather, validate, and apply configuration requests to enable capabilities suiting client business and technical needs.
* Collaborate closely with commercial, operations, and product teams to gather, evaluate, and summarize improvement opportunities within platform client onboarding processes.
* Develop and manage on\-shore functional programs and projects that enable US operational and organizational goals.
* Maintain and update customer account settings and pricing throughout the lifecycle of their relationship with Airwallex, ensuring accuracy and consistency across configurations.

* Experience managing multiple projects.
* Experience working with product and engineering teams.

**About the job**
-----------------


Product and Business Strategy Leaders bring together teams across Google’s functions to help products execute optimally. Our team pushes Google to scale at key points that refine our products and infrastructure by executing efficiently, bringing solid business sense and sound judgment, and working effectively across organizational lines.  

  

Our roles often include components of strategy (e.g. analyzing and understanding new trends in the industry, building business plans), operations (e.g. running the cadence of organizations, connecting the operating lines between our functions), and communications. Our team partners with senior leadership to run important functions that cross\-cut our existing organizations and deliver high impact projects. We help Engineers, PMs, UX, and all of our other functions to build amazing products that delight our users, and then get those products into their hands.



In this role, you will help shape the future of education by joining the newly formed Central Strategy and Operations team within the Education Unit. You will partner with cross\-functional teams—including GTM, PgM, Data Science, PM, Engineering, and UXR—and collaborate across Product Areas to create a cohesive user experience across multiple surfaces and AI offerings. You will apply business excellence and strategic structure to drive forward one of Google’s highest\-priority initiatives.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, AI Trust and Safety, Google Search, Anti-Abuse
jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in product management or related technical role, including experience building algorithmic, machine learning, or infrastructure platforms.
* 3 years of experience in Trust and Safety, web spam detection, anti\-abuse, or platform integrity.
* Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.
* Experience building product defenses against adversarial ML risks (e.g., prompt injection, data poisoning), synthetic text generation, or agentic automation.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning (ML), NLP, or a related quantitative field.
* 3 years of experience working with Policy and Legal teams to develop policies and communications for anti\-abuse, spam, or trust and safety products.
* Experience with search ecosystems (e.g., web crawling, indexing pipelines, information retrieval, and link\-graph analysis) with a track record of publishing research or leading industry consortia against web abuse.
* Experience communicating complex concepts to internal and external audiences, and navigating high\-ambiguity technical challenges from concept to production deployment at a multi\-million or billion\-user scale.

**About the job**
-----------------


At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  

  

In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  

  

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  


Google Search is dedicated to organizing the world’s information and making it universally accessible and useful. Maintaining user trust requires protecting Search from increasingly sophisticated adversarial threats. The proliferation of Generative AI, automated synthetic content networks, LLM\-driven parasite SEO, and agentic scraping has fundamentally transformed web spam from simple keyword manipulation into complex, automated adversarial campaigns.


As a Senior Product Manager for Google Search Anti\-Spam and Abuse, you will define and drive the multi\-year product strategy, technical architecture, and algorithmic defense mechanisms to combat AI\-driven abuse at a global scale. You will partner closely with Research Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Regulatory and Policy Experts, Anti\-Abuse experts, and Operations teams to ensure Search delivers high\-quality, authentic information.


In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $192000 \- $278000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Define and drive the multi\-year product strategy, goal, and project roadmaps for combating spam and adversarial threats on Search, securing buy\-in from cross\-functional teams.
* Lead PRDs and collaborate with Engineering and Analyst partner teams to operationalize mechanisms that proactively detect abuse trends, combat spam, and manage incidents for deviations from expected system behavior.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Policy, Legal, Trust and Safety, and Threat Intelligence to codify emerging abuse vectors and execute mitigation plans aligned with regulatory obligations.
* Build and own Go\-To\-Market (GTM) and comprehensive proactive/reactive communication plans for defense rollouts and policy updates.
* Define and own success metrics for anti\-abuse initiatives by leading processes to collect, track, and harmonize quantitative and qualitative product metrics.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. * Design creative, innovative, and scalable programs for all levels using adult learning theories and methodologies (such as ADDIE, SAM, AGILE)
* Develop course materials that use an array of different media to produce materials that promote learning through self\-study, practice, performance support, and socialization and knowledge sharing

* Establish project plans and leads teams in the development of new learning content by managing completion of milestones and deliverables
* Leads others and participates in the design of curriculum, instruction, and assessment materials using knowledge of current trends and best practices in learning and development
* Lead and manage learning solution design, measurement strategy, and project management

jobs.description:
### **Senior Research Project Manager, CHEER**


* 51174
* Remote, United States
* Full Time
  

**Position**: Senior Research Project Manager

**Department**: Pediatrics Research

**Schedule**: 40 hours per week, Remote

**POSITION SUMMARY:**


The Center for Health Equity, Education, and Research (CHEER) at Boston Medical Center is a world\-class center for maternal child health advocacy, training and research. Its mission is to bring about health equity by collaborating with community\-based partners and providing technical assistance, training, evaluation, and inspiration. CHEER focuses on underserved populations, with a particular emphasis on maternal child health and nutrition.

  

Under the supervision of CHEER’s Director and Associate Director, the Senior Research Project Manager (SRPM) will support the CHAMPS National program. CHAMPS is a hospital\-based initiative that promotes evidence\-based maternity practices, with the ultimate goal of increasing breastfeeding rates and decreasing racial disparities in breastfeeding. The new CHAMPS National program is a CDC funded program, which expands hospital enrollment to 100 sites around the US and its territories. The SRPM will develop protocols, assessment instruments, monitor program implementation, provide training, and assist with manuscripts, presentations and reporting to the CDC. The SRPM will provide support to CHAMPS National hospitals, enabling access to trainings, resources, and QI training. The SRPM will function as liaisons between CHAMPS National team members, QI specialists, and trainers, and hospital contacts.

 **JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**(These generally will be required but may not always apply based on department\-specific needs):**

 **Project Management**

* Coordinates and facilitates the research project management life cycle, including initiation, development, and implementation of various complex experimentation projects.
* Collaborates with other BU departments and universities on joint projects.
* Offers training and assistance to other facilities working with the CHEER program, provides expert guidance and direct assistance.
* Oversees outreach to facilities in different locations.
* Responsible for scoping, coordinating early research activities, training program staff, and managing implementation of QI training, and research.
* Coordinates research and hospital teams, and manages project timelines, to ensure milestones are completed within the specified and in line with annual objectives.
* Meets regularly with stakeholders, including research staff, contractors, project and study teams, to collect and communicate business and research requirements, and set expectations for research\-related work.
* Responsible for the completion of both research and project management deliverables, including project plans and research schedules, progress reports and investigational applications.

 **Research Management**

* Works with Principal Investigators to select the most appropriate methodology and techniques for facilitating the research.
* Responsible for producing qualitative and quantitative research plans, designing questionnaires and moderator guides.
* Works with research and program implementation teams (BMC based and off\-site), and the project and research directors, to coordinate fieldwork initiatives, and conduct pre\-research and post\-research analyses and evaluations.
* Works with research team to facilitate \& ensure protocol adherence, quality assurance and HIPAA compliance.
* Oversees data collection onsite and offsite, summarizes and interprets data.
* Collaborates with Principal Investigator to author journal articles and to present findings at research seminars, study groups and conferences.

 **Staff Management**

* Supervise support staff (e.g., Research Coordinators, Research Assistants, etc), including training, delegating tasks, overseeing daily activities, mentoring, guiding through demonstration of best practices and offering opportunities for professional development.
* Schedules and facilitates staff meetings. Plans agenda and ensures that minutes are taken, edited and distributed.

 **Administrative Duties**

* Assists the Principal Investigator with monitoring expenses, facilitating contracts, ordering materials and documenting all approved variances. Works with offsite team to oversee program expenses and offer guidance.
* Liaises as necessary with Institutional Review Board (IRB) for submissions, correspondence, and regulatory binders, including administrative amendments.
* Assists with development and writing of proposals to obtain funding for ongoing and future research activities.
* Perform administrative duties associated with the study’s Data Monitoring and Safety Board, tracking and reporting adverse events and collecting data specified by the DMSB. Responsible for all other administrative duties related to research activities.
* Performs other duties as required.

 **DEPARTMENT\-SPECIFIC DUTIES**

**DEPARTMENT: Division of General Pediatrics**

**RESEARCH STUDY OR CLINICAL TRIAL: CHEER (Center for Health Equity, Education and Research) based projects**

* Manage project\-specific work such as data collection, hospital meetings, hospital maternity staff trainings, and similar work

jobs.description:
**Job Title** **Instructional Designer II**
**Company Overview**
*As affiliates of the PCI Federal Services group of companies, PCI Government Services LLC has a passion for our team members and their personal mission for success. We offer excellent insurance, leave and developmental benefits along with some flexibility for remote work opportunities. Come join our organization and be part of an exciting team supporting our Federal, DoD and Private Sector customers!*
**Job Summary**
The Instructional Designer I is responsible for creating effective, engaging, and educational learning experiences across various delivery formats. This role requires collaboration with subject matter experts, instructional technologists, and stakeholders to develop content that meets learning objectives and enhances the learner’s experience.
This position is classified as exempt.
**Duties and Responsibilities***Training Design and Development:** Design and develop instructional materials, including course summary sheets, learning objectives, course outlines, storyboards, video scripts, and other supporting documents for training deliverables.
* Ensure that learning materials are clear, engaging, and aligned with specific learning outcomes.
* Design and develop interactive, SCORM\-compliant, Section 508\-compliant webinars.
* Design multimedia assets, including two\-dimensional and three\-dimensional graphics, motion graphics, and videos.
* Design and develop online, interactive training materials in various formats, including printable job aids, microlearning, videos, and eLearning courses.


*Collaboration and Consultation:** Collaborate with subject matter experts (SMEs) to gather content and ensure the accuracy and relevancy of learning materials.
* Work closely with stakeholders, including leadership teams and learners, to understand learning needs and objectives.
* Consult on learning technologies and platforms to select the best fit for course delivery.


*Learning Technology Integration:*
* Use learning management systems (LMS) to deploy courses and track learner progress.
* Program interactive, SCORM\-compliant, Section 508\-compliant mini\-lessons and full\-length eLearning courses in designated software (e.g., Lectora, Adobe, Captivate, Opigno).

*Assessment and Evaluation:** Develop formative and summative assessments to evaluate learners’ understanding of the content.
* Analyze learner data to assess the effectiveness of instructional interventions and make necessary improvements.
* Conduct pilot tests (as needed) and collect feedback from learners and program leadership to optimize learning materials.


*Continuous Improvement:** Stay updated with the latest trends and best practices in instructional design, adult learning theory, and eLearning technology.
* Recommend and implement innovations that enhance the overall learning experience.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Public Health, Instructional Design, Educational Technology, or a related field.
* Proven experience (4\-6 years) in supporting public health instructional design projects or similar roles.
* Experience with instructional design models and adult learning theories.
* Proficiency in eLearning development tools (e.g., Adobe Captivate, Lectora, etc.).
* Experience working with learning management systems (LMS).
* Strong project management, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to analyze learner needs and recommend appropriate solutions.


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Master’s degree in a relevant field.
* Certification in Instructional Design or related fields.
* Experience with video editing software and multimedia content creation.
* Knowledge of UX/UI principles as applied to learning technologies.
* Experience supporting federal or state government agencies, particularly public\-health focused agencies such as the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC).

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
WorkWave is seeking a highly analytical and results\-driven **Revenue Operations Analyst** to be a core driver of our revenue engine's efficiency and predictability. This role is responsible for transforming complex revenue data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations that support our entire Go\-To\-Market (GTM) leadership team.

The ideal candidate will be an expert in data modeling, live in Excel and BI tools, and play a key role in annual planning, performance measurement, and providing high\-urgency strategic analysis for the CRO, CEO, and Board.
### **WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

* **Data Analysis \& Insights:** Analyze core metrics (pipeline health, bookings, retention/churn, product usage, and ARR trends) to identify risks, opportunities, and performance drivers. Perform detailed cohort, segmentation, and funnel analysis.
* **Reporting \& Dashboarding:** Own the creation and maintenance of executive\-level dashboards (Salesforce, Looker/Tableau, or equivalent). Produce weekly business reviews, monthly KPI reports, and materials that support the C\-level and Board reporting process.
* **Forecasting \& Modeling:** Support the bookings forecast process and ensure sales data integrity within the CRM. Maintain and refine predictive models for capacity planning, rep productivity, territory performance, and support quota\-setting exercises.
* **Cross\-Functional Reporting Support:** Partner with Sales Management, Marketing Ops, CS Ops, and Product Ops to unify data sources and workflows (Salesforce, Pendo, Gainsight, Marketo, Snowflake, etc.). Ensure consistent data definitions and reporting standards across functions to support end\-to\-end funnel attribution.
* **Annual and Quarterly Planning:** Provide data\-driven insights to support annual and quarterly GTM initiatives, including quota\-setting, territory modeling, and headcount planning.
* **Process Measurement \& Optimization:** Measure the impact of new processes and enablement programs. Track KPI performance, identify GTM process breakdowns, and recommend operational changes to enhance efficiency and productivity.
* **Ad\-hoc Executive Analysis:** Respond quickly to high\-urgency requests from the VP of RevOps, CRO, and CFO with clean, accurate deep dives on win rates, product sales performance, ASP, churn drivers, and related strategic topics.

### **WHAT YOU'LL BRING:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Business Analytics, or related field.
* 5\-7\+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, FP\&A, or Business Analytics.
* Expert\-level proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets ( (index/match, nested logic, pivot tables, scenario modeling).
* Proficiency in Salesforce reporting and Business Intelligence (BI) tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, PowerBI, SQL, Python).
* Strong understanding of core SaaS metrics (ARR, NRR, CAC/LTV, pipeline conversion rates).
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex data into clear narratives and present findings to senior leadership.
* High attention to detail, comfort working with large datasets, and a proven ability to execute quickly in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to travel (10%)

### **WHAT WOULD ALSO BE AWESOME:**

* Prior experience supporting sales organizations with complex, multi\-product solution offerings.
* Familiarity with enterprise software or subscription business models.
* Experience with advanced RevTech tools like SalesForce, Tableau, PowerBI, Pendo and Gainsight.

jobs.description:
**About MJM Financial Partners**

At MJM Financial Partners, we believe financial planning is about much more than investments—it's about helping individuals and families make confident financial decisions that allow them to focus on what matters most.

As an independent financial planning practice, we are committed to delivering exceptional client experience built on responsiveness, trust, professionalism, and personalized service. Every interaction with a client should reflect our commitment to making financial planning organized, proactive, and effortless.

**Position Summary**

The Client Experience \& Operations Manager is a key member of the MJM Financial Partners team and serves as the trusted business partner to the Financial Advisor. This is a part\-time, fully remote position designed for a highly organized professional who can work independently while maintaining consistent communication and follow\-through.

This individual partners directly with the Financial Advisor to ensure clients receive an outstanding experience from their first interaction through every stage of the financial planning relationship. The role combines client relationship management, business operations, project coordination, and executive partnership into one highly visible position.

Success in this role means anticipating needs, driving execution, creating capacity for the Financial Advisor, and ensuring that every client interaction reflects the firm's commitment to excellence, responsiveness, and a bias for action.

**Primary Responsibilities**

**Client Experience**

* Own the client service experience from initial inquiry through ongoing relationship management.
* Coordinate meetings, follow\-up, annual reviews, and client communications.
* Ensure every client receives timely, proactive, and professional service.

**Business Operations**

* Coordinate all new client onboarding activities, including account openings, applications, required documentation, and workflow tracking.
* Maintain CRM accuracy and monitor operational processes.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and client experience.

**Executive Partnership**

* Track action items from client meetings and ensure commitments are completed.
* Coordinate travel, conferences, presentations, and business logistics.
* Serve as an extension of the Financial Advisor by anticipating needs and driving execution.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree preferred.
* 5\+ years of experience supporting a business owner, executive, or financial advisor.
* Financial services, wealth management, banking, insurance, or professional services experience strongly preferred.
* Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently in a remote environment, maintain responsiveness, and manage priorities with limited day\-to\-day oversight.
* Reliable internet access and an appropriate professional workspace for confidential client and business communications.
* Excellent communication and relationship\-building skills.
* High level of professionalism, discretion, initiative, and accountability.

**What Success Looks Like**

The successful candidate enables the Financial Advisor to spend more time serving clients and growing the business by ensuring that operations run smoothly, clients receive exceptional service, commitments are consistently executed, and MJM Financial Partners continues to deliver a first\-class client experience. In a remote environment, success also requires proactive communication, dependable availability during agreed working hours, and disciplined follow\-through on priorities and deadlines.

Pay: From $28\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Manager, People Operations
jobs.description:
### **About GovPilot:**


GovPilot provides cloud\-based software solutions to local governments, aiming to make our communities better places to live and work. As a mission\-driven company, GovPilot is committed to creating impactful technology that serves the public good.


We are looking for team members who take pride in their work and seek to consistently improve themselves, their skills, and their knowledge. If this sounds like you–and the type of work environment where you’d thrive–we hope you’ll join us!

### **What We Offer:**

* Competitive salary.
* Unlimited PTO.
* Flexible working hours and remote work options.
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.
* Professional development opportunities and learning budget.
* Home office and IT budget.
* Supportive team environment.
* The chance to work on innovative projects with cutting\-edge technologies.
 **The Position:**  

 We're looking for an experienced People Operations Manager to own the full breadth of HR operations for our growing organization. This person has previously managed HR for a 100\+ person company, or a comparable vertical/business unit within a larger organization, and is comfortable operating across both the strategic and tactical sides of HR — from policy and employee relations down to the details of payroll and benefits administration.


Our workforce is global and blended — a mix of full\-time employees, Employer of Record (EOR) arrangements, and independent contractors across multiple countries — and we currently operate through a PEO (Rippling). Experience navigating that kind of complexity, and comfort with the compliance nuances it creates, is essential to this role.

**What You Will Own:**

* **HR Operations \& Compliance.** Own day\-to\-day HR operations across the full employee lifecycle — onboarding, offboarding, leave administration, benefits, and compliance with federal, state, and local employment law.
* **Payroll \& Tactical HR.** Be hands\-on with the tactical side of HR, including payroll processing and troubleshooting, benefits administration, and PEO relationship management (currently Rippling).
* **Global Workforce Management.** Manage HR processes across a blended workforce of FTEs, EOR employees, and contractors in multiple countries, ensuring each classification is handled correctly and compliantly.
* **Employee Relations.** Serve as a trusted point of contact for employees and managers on HR matters, including performance issues, workplace concerns, and conflict resolution.
* **Policy \& Documentation.** Maintain and evolve employee handbooks, policies, and HR documentation to stay current with a growing, multi\-state, multi\-country workforce.
* **HR Systems \& Reporting.** Own HR systems administration (Rippling), ensuring accurate records, and provide reporting/metrics to leadership as needed.
* **Finance Partnership.** Work closely with the CFO on headcount forecasting, compensation administration, and budget\-related HR matters.

**What You Bring:**

* 5\+ years of progressive HR experience, including prior ownership of HR for a 100\+ person company or a comparable\-sized business unit.
* Strong working knowledge of global workforce structures — FTEs, EOR arrangements, and independent contractors — and the compliance considerations that come with each.
* Direct experience working with a PEO (Rippling experience a plus).
* Comfortable and capable handling tactical HR functions personally — payroll, benefits administration, systems — not just overseeing them.
* Solid grounding across all core HR disciplines: employee relations, compliance, recruitment, performance management, compensation, and HR systems.
* Excellent judgment and discretion in handling sensitive and confidential matters.

**What Makes You Stand Out:**

* Experience in a fast\-growing startup or SaaS environment.
* SHRM\-CP or PHR certification.

**Practicals:**

* You'll report to: Chief Financial Officer
* Location: Remote (US)
* Start date: As soon as possible
* Status: Full Time/Exempt
* Hiring Timeline: We expect to keep this posting open for 4 weeks.
* Please note: GovPilot is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

**How to Apply:**  

 If you are passionate about people and eager to help scale a growing organization, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your resume and cover letter today!

### **Application Process:**

* Screening call with a recruiter
* Hiring Manager Interview
* Team Interview
* Final Interview with GovPIlot CEO

### **Equal Opportunity Employer:**


GovPilot is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. It's important to us that our workforce reflects people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences and by providing this data, if you choose to, it will help us to stay accountable.

**Join us in creating amazing technology solutions that make a difference. Apply today!**

**PURPOSE**
-----------



APR Consulting Co is a strategic production consultancy at the forefront of the advertising industry and is seeking a CONTRACT PROJECT MANAGER to join our team.


**DEFINING SUCCESS FOR THIS ROLE**
----------------------------------



This position will be successful if they can demonstrate the following objectives and performance targets:


* Contribute to the overall financial health and success of our account portfolio by effectively supporting the Client Solutions team. This includes managing staffing and labor on project schedules, developing pricing and scope, and ensuring the internal planning and delivery of project deliverables.
* Act as a key partner to Group Directors, Managing Advisors, and other stakeholders. Assist in guiding the development, management, and delivery of scoped deliverables while assessing resource allocation and profitability.
* Challenge traditional methods and bring forward new ideas. Demonstrate a proactive approach by influencing internal processes and operational standards. Effectively manage and influence both peers and leadership, driving accountability and fostering a culture of continuous improvement across the organization.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
------------------------



This position’s key responsibilities include but are not limited to the following:



Account \& Portfolio Governance


* Oversee Client Solutions account performance, including labor tracking, billing accuracy, risk management, and scope adherence.
* Ensure scopes, deliverables, and services remain aligned with business objectives.
* Conduct impact analyses for scope changes and recommend next steps.
* Develop understanding of client scopes of work, cost outs, contracts and billing requirements – and manage to those goals
* Facilitate retrospectives, document lessons learned, and refine portfolio management processes.

Project Management Support


* Proactively maximize bandwidth by balancing core responsibilities with supplemental client and/or internal engagements, bridging resource gaps and support for PMO leadership.
* Offer peer coverage and assist with overflow workloads when needed.

Resource \& Staffing Coordination


* Contribute to the understanding of company capacity and individual capabilities through tracking what available personnel are working on now and in the future and identify any gaps
* Partner with Resource Management to resolve resource conflicts, determine workloads, and optimize utilization across accounts.
* Support Group Directors in resource allocation, tracking, and prioritization.
* Track project/retainer actuals against SOW hours, deliverables, or project counts.

Project Workflow \& Operations


* Lead effort to achieve project objectives
* Work with team to accurately scope out length and difficulty of tasks and projects
* Responsible for ensuring agreed\-upon project tasks are completed within scope, time, budget and quality constraints
* Support end\-to\-end account workflow including time management, scope delivery, and risk prioritization.
* Risk Planning – anticipate problems and roadblocks, engage in contingency planning and recommend solutions or alternative methods to negate risks
* Maintain process documentation, operational policies, production calendars, timelines, and reports.
* Schedule internal and client meetings; maintain documentation, file structure, and naming conventions.
* Manage team schedules, deadlines, reporting workflows, and client reporting calendar
* Seek opportunities to engage others in procedural improvements
* Engage in client business to larger degree, establishing strong ties with your Client Solutions leads and attending as many client meetings as possible
* Measure performance against goals

Business \& Financial Management


* Partner with Group Directors and Client Services on SOWs and staffing plans.
* Create and review project/retainer cost\-outs and track actuals against budget.
* Review burn reports, monitor contribution margins, and recommend adjustments to maintain financial alignment.
* Maintain detailed record of scope changes
* Manage financial milestones in APR systems and coordinate payment reconciliation with finance.
* Participate in monthly finance and billing reviews.

Departmental Contribution


* Collaborate, share knowledge, and support a culture of consistency, compliance, and operational excellence across teams—including global teams.
* Support the development, improvement and use of all company collaboration, archival and financial tools and systems to improve process and get work done efficiently

  

**ABOUT YOU**
-------------


* 6\-8 years experience as a Project Manager, Senior Project Manager, or similar in advertising/marketing industry
* PMP Certification (Project Management Professional) or actively working to obtain certification desired
* Proficiency in Google Workspace
* Experience with Deltek Workbook or Deltek products is a plus.
* Excellent communication skills (verbal and written).
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and adaptable.
* Calm and focused under pressure; assertive conflict\-resolution and problem\-solving skills.
* Effective decision\-maker, even under tight deadlines.
* Demonstrates confidence, professionalism, and diplomacy.
* Capable of establishing strong relationships and gaining trust from peers.
* Positive, collaborative, and solutions\-oriented.
* Embraces technology advancements and process changes.
* Future\-focused and technologically adept.
* Good listener, takes feedback well, and addresses problems.
* Lead, motivate and inspire with compassion and vision
