**OMEGA SYSTEMS JOB DESCRIPTION**
=================================

**Position:** Project Manager  

**Reports To:** VP of Service Delivery
  

**Division:** Technical Services
  

**FSLA:** Exempt  

  

This role is responsible for executing projects within established timelines, budgets, and quality standards while coordinating Systems Engineers and Project Engineers responsible for implementation. While not hands on technical, the Project Manager must possess strong technical literacy to translate SOWs into actionable plans, manage dependencies and risk, and ensure successful project delivery. You will partner with Engineers, CSMs, Account Managers, and clients to provide clear status reporting, maintain documentation, and uphold PMP based project management practices in a fast paced environment.


**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead project delivery from SOW to closeout: develop project plans, define milestones, resource assignments, acceptance criteria, and change control processes.
* Consolidate and prioritize multiple concurrent projects across accounts: maintain program level roadmaps, identify conflicts, sequence work to optimize engineer utilization and client impact.
* Coordinate cross functional stakeholders: work with Engineers, CSMs, AMs, and third party vendors to align expectations, scope, schedules, and deliverables.
* Resource and schedule management: assign engineers to tasks based on skills and availability, monitor workload, proactively rebalance assignments, and support time management to meet SLAs and timelines.
* Communication and reporting: produce and distribute regular status updates, executive summaries, project dashboards, and risk/issue logs to internal teams and client stakeholders.
* Risk, issue, and change control: identify and document risks, own mitigation plans, manage scope change requests, and obtain approvals per governance processes.
* Meeting facilitation and client engagement: run project kickoff, steering committee, and weekly status meetings; present technical progress in business terms for non technical stakeholders.
* Quality and acceptance: ensure engineers produce required technical deliverables (design docs, runbooks, test plans) and that acceptance criteria in the SOW are validated and signed off.
* Continuous improvement: capture lessons learned, refine project templates, and share best practices to improve delivery efficiency and documentation quality.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* PMP certification with 5\+ years managing technical projects; MSP experience preferred.
* Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent projects and consolidating workstreams into program level plans.
* Technical literacy across cloud, networking, virtualization, and server technologies to meaningfully guide engineers and translate technical status for stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder management skills: proven experience working with client executives, CSMs, AMs, technical teams, and vendors.
* Excellent written and verbal communication: status reports, executive summaries, and client facing updates.
* Solid scheduling and resource management skills: familiarity with MS Project, Smartsheet, or equivalent; comfortable optimizing engineer assignments and availability.
* Risk and change management proficiency: establish and run escalation paths, change approval workflows, and issue resolution processes.
* Process orientation and documentation skills: create and maintain project artifacts, RACI matrices, runbooks, and acceptance checklists.
* Comfortable with tools common in MSP environments: ConnectWise or similar PSA, IT Glue, and collaboration platforms (Teams/SharePoint/Confluence).
* Ability to manage multiple customers and prioritize expedited activities.
* Ability to travel occasionally for client meetings or on site project phases.

**Desired Certifications \& Knowledge**

* PMP; Agile/Scrum experience a plus.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS) and networking fundamentals is strongly preferred.
* Experience with financial/project tracking tools and familiarity with MSP billing/renewal cycles.

**Location \& Schedule**

* Hybrid or remote with periodic on site client engagements and occasional travel
* Flexible hours to accommodate clients and engineer coordination across time zones
* Incumbent(s) in this position may be required to perform other duties and special assignments not specifically stated.

**Environmental**: The job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, etc.

jobs.description:
CAD/RMS Project Coordinator

We are seeking a highly organized and knowledgeable **CAD/RMS Project Coordinator** to support the successful implementation and delivery of public safety software projects. This role will serve as a key liaison between clients, internal teams, and stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.

The ideal candidate will have experience working within the **public safety technology industry**, with a strong understanding of **Computer\-Aided Dispatch (CAD)** and **Records Management Systems (RMS)**. This individual will be responsible for project planning, schedule management, scope coordination, stakeholder communication, client training, and ensuring projects remain on track from kickoff through implementation.

A strong working knowledge of **CRM systems** is critical to this role, as the Project Coordinator will be expected to maintain accurate project records, document customer interactions, track milestones, and provide clear and consistent status updates.

Responsibilities

* Coordinate and support CAD and RMS implementation projects from project kickoff through completion.
* Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, deliverables, and action items.
* Monitor project progress to ensure deadlines are met and work remains within the defined project scope.
* Identify potential risks, delays, or scope concerns and communicate them proactively to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Serve as a primary point of coordination between customers, project stakeholders, development teams, technical resources, and internal departments.
* Conduct regular project meetings and provide detailed, accurate status updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Document meeting notes, decisions, action items, project requirements, and follow\-up activities.
* Maintain accurate and timely project information within the company CRM, including project status, client communications, milestones, tasks, and relevant documentation.
* Coordinate closely with development and technical teams to communicate customer requirements, track outstanding issues, and support timely resolution.
* Assist with gathering and documenting business, operational, and technical requirements related to CAD and RMS implementations.
* Coordinate and deliver training for end users, system administrators, supervisors, and other customer personnel.
* Develop or assist with training plans, training materials, system documentation, and implementation resources.
* Support customers throughout testing, configuration, implementation, go\-live, and post\-implementation activities.
* Maintain organized project documentation, reports, spreadsheets, correspondence, and supporting records.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with public safety clients while providing a high level of customer service throughout the project lifecycle.
* Support continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance project processes, communication, documentation, and customer experience.

Qualifications

* Experience working with **public safety software**, specifically **CAD and/or RMS systems**, strongly preferred.
* Understanding of public safety operations, workflows, terminology, and agency environments.
* Previous experience in project coordination, software implementation, customer success, professional services, or a related role.
* Strong project planning and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Demonstrated ability to keep projects aligned with established scope, timelines, and deliverables.
* Strong working knowledge of **CRM systems** and the ability to maintain complete and accurate project and customer records.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with agency personnel, executives, technical teams, and other stakeholders.
* Experience conducting customer meetings, documenting requirements, and providing detailed project status updates.
* Ability to work collaboratively with software development, implementation, support, and technical teams.
* Experience training end users and system administrators on software applications.
* Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams.
* High attention to detail with strong documentation, follow\-up, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership of assigned projects, and proactively address issues.
* Customer\-focused mindset with the ability to build and maintain strong professional relationships.

Preferred Qualifications

* Direct experience implementing or supporting **CAD, RMS, Mobile, Jail Management, Evidence, or other public safety technology solutions**.
* Experience working with law enforcement agencies, fire departments, EMS agencies, dispatch centers, or public safety answering points.
* Familiarity with software development and implementation processes.
* Experience with software configuration, testing, data migration, or go\-live support.
* Experience developing or delivering software training programs.

What Success Looks Like

The successful CAD/RMS Project Coordinator will be someone who understands both the operational needs of public safety agencies and the discipline required to manage successful software implementations. You will keep projects organized, communicate proactively, maintain accurate records, anticipate potential challenges, and ensure customers and internal teams remain aligned throughout every phase of the project.

If you are passionate about public safety technology, enjoy working directly with customers, and thrive in an environment where organization, communication, and accountability are critical, we would welcome the opportunity to speak with you.

* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off

jobs.title: Maintenance Training Manager
jobs.description:
The Maintenance Training Manager is responsible for developing, implementing, and managing technical training programs for aircraft maintenance personnel within the organization. This position ensures maintenance training programs meet FAA regulations, OEM standards, and internal safety and quality requirements.



The Maintenance Training Manager oversees training schedules, tracks certifications, conducts audits, evaluates training effectiveness, and works closely with Maintenance, Quality, Safety, Operations, Human Resources, and other organizational stakeholders to ensure maintenance personnel remain proficient, compliant, and prepared to support safe air medical operations.

  


**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**

* Deliver engaging training through classroom instruction, hands\-on demonstrations, virtual learning, simulations, group discussions, and other instructional methods.
* Conduct audits to ensure compliance with company policies and applicable industry regulations.
* Review existing training programs and recommend enhancements to improve engagement, learning, retention, and effectiveness.
* Organize and conduct monthly induction and orientation sessions.
* Maintain current knowledge of maintenance software systems, industry best practices, software releases, and emerging technologies.
* Provide ongoing technical support and guidance to maintenance personnel regarding maintenance software systems and functionality.
* Maintain accurate training records, attendance documentation, evaluations, and training materials.
* Prepare reports regarding training outcomes, effectiveness, and opportunities for improvement.

* Collaborate with Maintenance, Quality, Safety, Operations, Human Resources, Regional Managers, software vendors, and other stakeholders.
* Participate in cross\-functional projects requiring maintenance training expertise.

* High school diploma or equivalent.

* Ability to simultaneously manage multiple training initiatives, schedules, records, and compliance requirements.
* Ability to work collaboratively across Maintenance, Quality, Safety, Operations, Human Resources, and other organizational departments.
* Ability to travel as required and work a flexible schedule when operational or training needs require.
* Valid driver's license.

**Preferred Qualifications**

The Senior Technical Account Manager (TAM) is a high\-impact individual contributor who supports Fenix24's priority customer relationships through technical expertise, proactive account management, and cross\-team coordination. Acting as a trusted advisor, the Senior TAM helps customers optimize their managed services experience across firewalls, backups, endpoint management, and platforms like Cohesity and Totango — working closely with engineering, NOC/SOC, and product teams to resolve complex issues and drive strong outcomes.

* Identify expansion opportunities (multi\-year agreements, broader firewall/endpoint deployments); support sales on renewals and executive presentations; act as SME on managed backups, firewalls, and endpoint security; contribute to webinars and client training

  


**Qualifications, Requirements \& Preferred Skills**

jobs.title: Member Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**
Calibrate is on a mission to change the way the world treats weight by redefining obesity care as a matter of biology, not willpower. Designed by world leaders in metabolic health, our program combines clinical research, personalized coaching, and lifestyle intervention to deliver lasting weight loss and improved metabolic outcomes. With obesity as America’s largest chronic condition, impacting 175mm adults in a $600B market, we’re closing the care gap by offering the first value\-based model in obesity treatment.

  

Since launching Direct\-to\-Consumer in 2020, we’ve expanded into Enterprise channels to improve access, and our app\-based experience supports members with coaching, tailored education, daily tracking, and community engagement across the four pillars of metabolic health: food, sleep, exercise, and emotional wellbeing.

 **ABOUT THE ROLE**


A Member Care Coordinator sits at the intersection of Member Experience and Clinical Operations. The role of a Member Care Coordinator is to ensure that members receive timely, coordinated, and high quality care; acting as the “glue” between the Clinical, Coaching, and Operational teams. They ensure smooth handoffs between teams, including but not limited to, tracking lab results, medication approvals, and any necessary follow up to ensure members proceed through their journey seamlessly.

 **This is a full\-time, hourly role with a hourly rate of $20\-22 per hour. We are offering three different shifts:**

  

* Monday \- Friday 8am \- 4:30pm ET
* Monday \- Friday 9:30am \- 6pm ET
* Monday \- Friday 10:30am \- 7pm ET

 **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Execute critical clinical administrative workflows focusing on resolving readiness barriers to accelerate members toward provider review and medication access.
* Own member escalations, including issue resolution and member communication.
* Facilitate provider workflow efficiency by preparing clinical documents and proactively triaging member needs for specialty support.
* Facilitate structured handoffs of critical information to Clinical and Coaching teams to ensure timely follow\-up regarding changes in medication, denials, or approved exception paths.
* Engage in cross\-functional meetings and work collaboratively with other departments to improve and maintain a high level of member care.
* Identify and formally report recurring systemic issues, submission errors, or trends that contribute to operational friction.
* Manage the end\-to\-end medication access workflow with complete ownership, including the proactive gathering of relevant clinical data, coordinating with clinicians for additional necessary information, complex Prior Authorization (PA) submission, denial investigation, appeal documentation, final determination and overrides when applicable.
* Proactively contact members via phone and secure message to request necessary information (e.g., previous prescription history, documentation) and deliver clarity regarding complex PA status changes or delays.
* Conduct outbound calls to insurance carriers, PBMs, and pharmacies to obtain specific case statuses, track documentation, and secure approvals.
* Ensure all communication, investigation notes, and PA statuses are accurately logged in the case management system (e.g., Zendesk, MJD) to maintain a complete and auditable member record.
* Initiate and resolve pharmacy\-level rejections (e.g., refill too soon, insurance coding errors, wrong dose dispensed) by conducting outbound calls to dispensing pharmacies and PBM help desks.
* Troubleshoot technical or administrative insurance issues that prevent successful claims processing.

 **BACKGROUND \& EXPERIENCE**

* Completion of a formal medical assisting program is highly valued. Preference will be given to candidates who hold a national certification, such as Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) awarded by the AAMA or Registered Medical Assistant (RMA) awarded by the AMT.
* Familiarity with case management systems (e.g., Zendesk), Electronic Health Records (EHR), and PA/e\-prescribing platforms is highly desirable.
* 2\+ years of high\-volume customer service, call center, or patient advocacy experience, preferably in a healthcare, pharmacy, or PBM setting.
* Demonstrated track record of managing complex, multi\-step processes where follow\-up and persistence are critical to success (i.e., comfortable making multiple calls to solve a single problem).
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the proven ability to handle challenging, escalated calls/messages with professionalism and empathy.
* Ability to meet the position’s attendance and scheduling requirements in a reliable and consistent manner.

 **SKILLS \& ATTRITBUTES**

* Demonstrated proficiency in medical terminology and clinical documentation to accurately interpret patient charts, understand treatment plans, and effectively communicate with clinical providers and payers.
* Strong organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail in documentation.
* Proficiency in interpreting and translating complex insurance terminology for the member.
* Proactive problem solver with a self\-starter mentality.
* Ability to work independently and manage case load effectively.

 **BENEFITS**

*At Calibrate, we’re committed to putting our team members in control of their health. In 2026, we are proudly offering the following benefits:*

* Enjoy a generous paid time off policy, including multiple paid company holidays, wellness days, and floating holidays to support your work\-life blend.
* Medical, dental, and vision benefit options to keep you and your family healthy.
* Calibrate\-funded disability and basic life insurance, ensuring peace of mind during unforeseen events.
* Access to several wellness programs, including a complimentary Headspace membership, and therapy on your schedule with Headspace Care.
* Employee Assistance Program through Principal to receive counseling on a wide range of topics.
* Remote\

TNT Growth is a performance marketing agency operating at the intersection of growth strategy, paid media, and creative production for DTC and B2B brands. We’re a remote\-first team of 30\+ people running on EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) and building the operational infrastructure to scale.

**About This Role**
===================


We’re hiring a Business Operations Associate to join our team on a contract\-to\-hire basis. This role has two phases:

**Phase 1 (Weeks 1–12\):** You’ll serve as interim operational coverage during a planned leadership leave, working directly with the CEO and department leads across finance, people operations, and company operations. This is a high\-trust, high\-visibility period where you’ll keep critical business functions running smoothly.

**Phase 2 (Ongoing):** Once the leave period ends, the role transitions to its permanent scope — owning the day\-to\-day of people operations support, project management, operational reporting, and cross\-functional coordination. If the contract goes well, you convert to full\-time with an expanded seat on the business operations team.

**Phase 1: Interim Responsibilities (Weeks 1–12\)**
===================================================


During the leave period, you will be the operational point person across finance and company operations. The CEO will retain final decision\-making authority, but you are responsible for the day\-to\-day execution, triage, and follow\-through.

**Finance Operations**

* **Contractor invoice review:** Review incoming contractor invoices against the financial forecast. Flag discrepancies, missing costs, or new vendors not yet in projections to Finance and escalate to the CEO as needed.
* **Cost tracker oversight:** Periodically review the cost tracker for accuracy. Verify invoice numbers, identify unbilled client costs, and flag billing discrepancies (e.g., clients being served without signed agreements or deposits on file).
* **Subscription and credit card management:** Maintain the master list of software subscriptions across all departments — tracking which tool is on which card and who owns it. Catch orphaned subscriptions, duplicate tools, and charges on the wrong card. Coordinate card migrations when team members depart or change roles.
* **Headcount and software request triage:** Monitor the automated approval workflow in Slack for new headcount and software purchase requests. Ensure business cases are complete and route to Finance and the CEO for approval. Work with people \& talent lead to determine salary range for roles.
* **Finance meeting support:** Help prepare for and support periodic finance review meetings. Track action items, follow up on open billing issues, and ensure recurring reviews happen on schedule.
* **End\-of\-quarter and year\-end support:** Assist Finance with quarterly close activities and budget reconciliation. Support year\-end planning by gathering data, tracking deadlines, and coordinating across departments.

**Company Operations**

* **Executive meeting support:** Prepare agendas, track action items, and maintain documentation for the weekly executive meeting. Ensure follow\-through on decisions made in leadership meetings.
* **Operating system support:** Help maintain and reinforce the company’s EOS implementation — ensure scorecard data is updated, rocks are tracked, and meeting cadences are followed across departments.
* **Contract management support:** Support Client Success and Sales with active contract management — tracking signature status on addendums, SOWs, and new agreements. Flag renewals and ensure in\-progress contracts don’t stall.
* **End\-of\-year performance planning:** Work with the CEO and executive team to determine what end\-of\-year performance evaluation looks like and support the planning process.
* **Cross\-department coordination:** Serve as the operational connective tissue between Finance, People Ops, Client Success, and department leads. Triage incoming operational requests and route them to the right owner.
* **Performance review execution:** Partner with the People \& Talent Lead to execute the end\-of\-year performance review cycle — coordinating timelines, compiling self\-assessments and manager feedback, and ensuring reviews are completed on schedule across all departments.

**Phase 2: Ongoing Responsibilities**
=====================================


After the leave period, this role settles into its permanent scope. You’ll continue to own and build on the areas below as the company scales.

**People Operations**

* **Headcount approval coordination:** Guide new headcount requests from reviewing the business case through budget approval to confirming the job description with People Operations/Recruiting. Ensure requests are complete and well\-documented before routing to Finance and the CEO for final sign\-off.

#### **What's in it for you?**



Ready to make a serious impact? Millions of people already rely on Calendly, and we're still in the midst of exciting product growth — it's a fantastic time to join us. Everything you'll work on here will accelerate your career to the next level. If you want to learn, grow, and do the best work of your life alongside the best people you've ever worked with, then we hope you'll consider allowing Calendly to be a part of your professional journey.

### **A day in the life of a Staff Product Manager at Calendly**



This technical product management position will report to the Head of Engineering, Growth and Customer foundations team. We strive to design a seamless product experience that delights our customers. In 2026, Calendly chartered a company\-wide initiative to focus on delivering *Great Customer Experience* \-spanning our Help Center, AI support bot, Automated issue resolution, human support escalations and support engineering. We're hiring a technical Staff Product Manager to work across Product, Go to Market (GTM) stakeholders, marketing, customer support and multiple engineering squads to address real gaps in taxonomy, measurement, and process. This product manager will own the roadmap end\-to\-end and turn a set of disconnected efforts into a durable, multi\-quarter capability that will drive defined growth, product/business outcomes, and customer satisfaction goals.


### **On a typical day, you will be working on**


* **Own the strategy, roadmap, and outcomes** for Calendly's intelligent customer experience, spanning AI support quality, automated resolution, and human escalation
* **Increase automated resolution** by enabling the Support Agent to accurately answer questions and take actions on behalf of customers, while reserving human support for high\-value and complex issues
* **Define and improve AI quality**, including answer accuracy, resolution quality, escalation effectiveness, and the failure modes that prevent customers from getting the right outcome
* **Build the measurement and observability layer** for Agent/Bot Quality Score, automated resolution rate, customer experience cycle time, escalation routing, and customer satisfaction
* **Establish and drive adoption of a company\-wide "supportability contract"** so every new Calendly capability is supportable by AI agents, automation, or human support from day one
* **Close the loop between customer issues and R\&D**, ensuring recurring bugs, product gaps, and support insights translate into prioritized product and engineering actions.
* **Lead across Product, Engineering, AI/Data, Growth, Monetization, Trust \& Safety, Support, and Content Operations** to turn fragmented customer\-support efforts into a durable, scalable company capability
* **Use customer feedback, support data, and experimentation** to continuously improve the experience, prioritize investments, and measure progress against clear customer and business outcomes

### **What do we need from you?**


* This hybrid opportunity is open exclusively to candidates currently residing in California who can commute to our San Francisco Bay Area office
* A minimum of 10\+ years of varied PM experience across both startups and scaled companies, including time spent building 0\-to\-1 platforms or capabilities that other internal teams had to adopt
* Direct experience with AI\-powered agents and/or conversational agents. You have relevant experience and deeply understand where these systems actually fail and what moves answer quality, not just the pitch
* A track record of driving cross\-functional standards or platform adoption across teams you don't manage — this role has real influence\-without\-authority demands from day one
* Strong product sense grounded in support and/or Customer experience data. Comfortable defining metrics from messy or incomplete data rather than waiting for a clean dashboard.
* Ability to build a bold and ambitious vision for the organization with ability to inspire teams to achieve a bold mission
* Experience partnering with GTM (support, success, content) and R\&D stakeholders simultaneously, ideally in a Business to Customer (B2C) and/or Business to Business (B2B) Software as a Service (SaaS), product\-led\-growth environment
* Authorized to work lawfully in the United States of America as Calendly does not engage in immigration sponsorship at this time

### **What's in it for you?**



Ready to make a serious impact? Millions of people already rely on Calendly's products, and we're still in the midst of our growth curve — it's a phenomenal time to join us. Everything you'll work on here will accelerate your career to the next level. If you want to learn, grow, and do the best work of your life alongside the best people you've ever worked with, then we hope you'll consider allowing Calendly to be a part of your professional career.


### **Our Hiring Process:**



Typically, individuals will participate in the following interview process. However, there may be slight nuances given the role and or department we are hiring for. Please keep in mind that individuals can be declined from the position at any stage of the process.


* Qualified individuals will be invited to schedule a phone interview with a member of our recruiting team. This is a great time to ask any initial questions you have about the company or the role.
* Next, we'll put you in direct contact with your potential manager. You'll get a chance to learn even more about life at Calendly, the responsibilities within your role, and the qualities needed to succeed here.
* Then, you will perform an interview exercise, where you can highlight your skills.
* Next, or in parallel, you'll meet with your potential team members.
* Finally, we connect with those you've worked with before, to learn more about the impact you can make, the value you bring, and the best way to set you up for success at Calendly.

new_jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI\-powered user interviews.


Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

  

The research industry is massive (\>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high\-cost services. That's our opportunity.

  

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures.


The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people.


We’re a tight\-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.


As a Scaled Customer Success Manager, you'll own adoption, retention, and growth across a mature portfolio of 100–200\+ accounts in our Scaled segment — and you'll build the systems that make covering a book that size possible.


You'll determine the right signals, automate analysis and follow\-ups, and design an operating model that gives customers an excellent experience. Roughly 70% of your time will be portfolio management; the other 30% will be building the infrastructure and process behind it — working closely with RevOps, Marketing, and Engineering.


This is a foundational hire. The health scoring, playbooks, and operating cadences you build will be the ones the team runs on for years, and you'll help define what "Scaled" means at Outset as the segment grows.

**Responsibilities**

* Own adoption, retention, and expansion outcomes across a portfolio of 100–200\+ Scaled accounts, from onboarding through renewal
* Keep usage and adoption high in a deliberately lower\-touch model — leverage programs, automation, and self\-service before reaching for a calendar invite
* Monitor account health and usage signals to catch risk and expansion opportunities early, and prioritize where your direct time actually changes the outcome
* Run renewals across a mixed model of actively managed and auto\-renewing accounts, partnering with our broader CS team on commercial approach
* Build and run one\-to\-many programs: onboarding cohorts, office hours, webinars, in\-product guidance, documentation, and templated success plans
* Develop our account health tracking methodology from the ground up — what signals matter, how they're weighted, how they trigger action, and how we know the scoring is predictive
* Partner cross\-functionally with RevOps, Marketing, and Engineering to build the infrastructure behind scaled CS: usage instrumentation, alerting, lifecycle triggers, and automated follow\-up
* Design the operational cadence for this segment: what regular communication looks like, how issues route to and from Product Support, and what escalation looks like. (Product Support owns ticket resolution. You own the process around it).
* Build reporting in Hex and with other AI tools that gives the business real visibility into Scaled segment health, adoption, and retention
* Translate portfolio\-wide patterns into prioritized input for Product

**Qualifications**

* 3–7 years in customer success, account management, CS operations, sales, or lifecycle/growth, including a high\-volume portfolio
* Experience building scaled or digital CS programs from scratch, or working as one of the first hires in a scaled CS role
* Technically fluent and self\-sufficient with data: product analytics and usage, pulling data with AI tools, and building tooling with AI
* Hands\-on with a modern GTM and support stack. Ours is Pylon, Hex, HubSpot, Salesforce, and Claude; we lean heavily on AI day to day and expect you to as well
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Series A/B/C or fast\-paced SaaS experience, with a proactive, ownership\-driven approach to ambiguity

**Nice to have**

* Experience defining or re\-segmenting a customer base, or standing up a support model for a new segment
* Background in customer marketing, growth, or RevOps
* Familiarity with research operations or market research

new_jobs.title: Data Center Operations Manager (Site, Facility Operations)
new_jobs.description:
**Built to set the gold standard for integrated AI infrastructure**

  

Crux AI is a newly formed, U.S.\-based integrated AI infrastructure company created to remove the physical and operational constraints on consequential AI ambitions. Crux brings together power, high\-density data centers, TPU silicon, networking, orchestration software, and ongoing operations as one integrated system.

  

Crux is being capitalized to plan every layer together, develop each one to demanding standards, and operate the whole system with efficiency and reliability. That gives hyperscalers, frontier AI labs, sovereign customers, enterprises, and AI\-native companies greater freedom to pursue the AI they are here to create.

 **WHAT YOU'LL DO**


You will own critical facility operations for one Crux site or campus — the electrical, mechanical, fire/life\-safety, and controls infrastructure that keeps high\-density, liquid\-cooled TPU clusters continuously available. You will lead the 24/7 site facility team — chief engineer, shift technicians, and O\&M contractors — and run the maintenance, procedures, drills, and change control that produce uptime, whether the building is Crux\-owned or operated by a colocation partner you hold to SLA. In the early phase you will help bring the site to life: commissioning participation, acceptance, and the transition from construction to disciplined steady\-state operations.

**In this role, you will:**

* Establish and direct the site facility operations team — chief engineer, critical facility technicians, and contractors — with a 24/7 coverage model you design, staff, and train, maintaining highly available operations for all critical and non\-critical infrastructure.
* Operate and maintain the site’s electrical systems (utility interface through switchgear, generators, UPS, and distribution), mechanical plant (chilled water, direct\-to\-chip liquid cooling loops, CDUs, heat rejection), fire/life\-safety, and BMS/EPMS controls.
* Run the site maintenance program in CMMS — preventive, predictive, and corrective — with vendor and OEM service contracts managed to scope, and zero tolerance for overdue critical PMs.
* Enforce operating discipline: SOPs/MOPs/EOPs current and rehearsed, change management on every energized system, drill program run on schedule, and monthly self\-assessments presented to fleet leadership.
* Lead site incident response for facility events end to end — detection, stabilization, escalation, root cause, corrective action — including communication when customer workloads are at risk.
* On partner sites, manage the colocation operator to contracted SLAs: audit their maintenance records, witness their critical work, and enforce remedies when performance slips.
* Support site bring\-up: participate in commissioning through Level 5/IST, define and enforce ops acceptance criteria, tune the cooling plant to design intent in the first year, and manage warranty claims.
* Own the site facility budget, utility coordination, and efficiency performance (PUE, WUE, energy cost), and run a safety\-first culture (LOTO, energized work controls, working at height) with zero\-compromise standards.

**SIGNALS OF SUCCESS**

**After 60 days in this role:**

* Site staffing plan and 24/7 coverage model will be approved with hiring in motion.
* Ops acceptance criteria will be agreed upon with construction/commissioning.

**After 6 months:**

* CMMS is loaded with the site asset registry and PM schedules.
* Procedures library is drafted for every critical system (or partner program audited, on a colo site).

**After 1 year:**

* First site is operating with 24/7 coverage under the full standards library.
* Preventive maintenance program is live in CMMS with zero overdue critical PMs.
* Incident and change management program running.
* Colo partner SLA and audit program in force at partner sites.

**EXPERIENCES, ATTRIBUTES AND MINDSET THAT INDICATE A GOOD MATCH**

**Experiences**

* 10\+ years in critical facility or data center operations — including power generation, HVAC, or mission\-critical military/industrial environments — with 5\+ years managing technical teams and vendors operating, maintaining, and troubleshooting electrical, mechanical, and controls infrastructure in a 24/7 environment.
* Comprehensive working knowledge of electrical topologies (N\+1/2N, UPS, generators, switchgear), mechanical and liquid cooling systems, fire/life\-safety, and building automation — plus the safety programs (LOTO, hazardous energy control) that govern work on them.
* Site bring\-up or major expansion experience: commissioning participation, acceptance testing, and the construction\-to\-operations handoff on a mission\-critical facility.

**Attributes**

* *Owner of the building.* When the plant alarms at 2am it is yours until the site is stable and the root cause is written down. You are comfortable being the most senior Crux person on site and making the call under pressure.
* *Discipline without bureaucracy.* You run tight MOPs, drills, and change control because they prevent outages, and you kill process that does not — and you can tell the difference.

**Mindset**

* *High tolerance for ambiguity.* The site will energize before every procedure exists. You write the SOP, run it, fix it, and hand it to the next site rather than waiting for a standard to arrive.
* *AI\-agentic first.* Fluent with AI agents — or committed to becoming so quickly — and you embed them as first principles in how you and your team work, defaulting to agentic workflows before adding headcount or process.

**Nice to have (preferred, not required)**

* 7\+ years in Tier III/IV or hyperscale data center environments (Meta, Google, AWS, Microsoft, or a major colo operator).
* Direct\-to\-chip liquid cooling plant operations experience (CDUs, water chemistry, loop commissioning and tuning).
* Trade certifications (Electrical, HVAC, Controls), stationary engineer license, or military/nuclear power backgro

new_jobs.description:
### **Position**

**ASSOCIATE PROGRAM MANAGER, PACKAGING**

**ABOUT KENDO**

Kendo Holdings, Inc. is a San Francisco\-based beauty brand developer and wholesaler owned by LVMH Moët Hennessy \- Louis Vuitton, the world’s largest luxury group. A play on the words “can do”, Kendo has become the hub of creativity and next generation beauty product development for global Sephora channels and selective retailers outside of Sephora.


Through original development, collaborations and acquisitions the Kendo stable of brands will always be creative, inspiring and innovative. A dynamic engine of speed, expertise and market\-savvy, the Kendo team continues to redefine the beauty industry through great product, great storytelling, great retail and direct\-to\-consumer partnerships. This shows up in everything we do and in what we stand for:


* “Can Do” Spirit: We work together to make our wildest dreams a reality: As entrepreneurs, we embrace optimism and find creative ways to reach our goals
* Advocacy, Diversity, and Inclusion: We recognize and celebrate the full spectrum of personal identities. We create safe spaces so everyone’s voice is heard. We listen with humility and act with courage.
* Storytelling: We tell authentic stories like no, one else. It’s our key to inspire trust and build relationships, rallying, our people, partners, and consumers around our brands.
* Resilience: We embrace challenges as opportunities. Change is ever\- constant, and agility is our strength.
Product Excellence: We put the consumers first: We constantly raise the bar to create products of the highest quality that everyone just has to have.  
* 

The salary range for this position is $81,900 \- $94,300 per year. Offered salary is dependent upon experience and San Francisco location. This is a hybrid role based in our downtown San Francisco office – Tues through Thursday in\-office, with Monday and Friday remote.


Kendo Total Rewards offerings also include an annual bonus and a comprehensive benefits package including: medical, dental and vision insurance, flex paid time off program, parental leave, employee discount/perks, a retirement plan with employer contributions, Summer Fridays, opportunity to work from anywhere for two weeks during the calendar year and December wellness/shutdown week for applicable positions.


The Kendo house of brands currently includes: Fenty Beauty, Fenty Skin, Fenty Eau de Parfum, Fenty Hair, Ole Henriksen, Lip Lab.  



**SUMMARY**

Independent self\-starter responsible for managing the creative development of packaging artwork for two Kendo brands. Responsible for ensuring on\-time delivery of packaging artwork \& deliverables throughout the creative process, from concept development through final execution.


### **Job responsibilities**

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Manages packaging creation and delivery process (70%):**

* Assist in bi\-weekly status meeting, keep team leads informed and discuss status for each project while establishing clear next steps resolving blocks that impede progress
* Upload and monitor individual project timelines through Asana
* Actively monitor schedules and follow\-up on internal copy/layout/mechanical due dates to ensure teams meet deadlines throughout lifespan of each artwork piece
* Follow up with team leads for missing packaging information (e.g., dielines, ingredient lists, copy, translations, UPCs, fill weight, etc.). Add dielines, ingredient lists, fill weights, UPCs to server.
* Work directly with Regulatory \& Compliance team to track and confirm EU artwork approval
* Communicate projects to Production Artists and outline daily priorities
* Follow up on questions/approvals with internal teams
* Collaborate with Production Artist to confirm artwork releases and approvals of samples
* Actively participate in weekly Product Development and Operation meetings
* Track comp requests for photo shoots, Market Week, etc.

**Manage artwork routing process (30%):**

* Upload and route artwork in ProofHQ: ensure all questions are resolved and Production Artists are clear on changes
* Review/Check\-in artwork from Production Artists
### **Profile**

**REQUIREMENTS**

* BA degree or equivalent experience preferred
* 2\+ years of project management experience in retail or agency
* Proficient knowledge of computer programs: Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Asana, Workfront Proof SmartSheets
* Retail or beauty experience preferred
* Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal
* Solid organizational skills, detail\-oriented; time management skills, ability to juggle priorities
* Strong relationship\-building skills; ability to work with a variety of people in various disciplines
* Ability to work in a very fast paced environment and meet very tight deadlines
* The drive to excel and succeed; self\-motivated
* Passion for beauty and retail
***Crafting Dreams Starts With Yours***
---------------------------------------

**At LVMH, people make the difference in the art of crafting dreams.**  

Our people fuel our dynamic, entrepreneurial culture. We value collective ambitions, encouraging our talents to push boundaries and champion a curious, audacious state of mind. Our commitment to excellence is reflected in nurturing every individual with a growth mindset and development opportunities, consistently empowering them to reach their full potential. We are actively committed to positive impact through an inclusive environment that supports and gives back to our talented community.
  

Join us at LVMH, where your talent is at the heart of our collective successes.

We are seeking a Program Manager to join Meta's Global Product Quality (GPQ) team to support payments testing across Meta's product portfolio and contribute to the broader International Testing Program (ITP). You will manage vendor delivery, contribute to testing methodology design, and work with product, engineering, and i18n teams to turn test results into actionable recommendations. The role requires someone who is comfortable working collaboratively across a shared portfolio, applying automation to improve how testing gets delivered, and operating across multiple product lines and geographies, prioritizing based on business impact and timelines.Payments are core to how people and businesses transact across the Meta family of apps, and test cards and simulated environments can only take validation so far — real coverage requires testing with real payment methods, in\-country, the way people actually pay. Your primary focus will be Meta's payments testing programs: coordinating in\-country testing with real local payment methods, and managing the sourcing and lifecycle of real payment instruments that Meta teams use to validate flows synthetic credentials cannot reach. Beyond payments, you will support the wider ITP mission of ensuring Meta's products function as intended in every market we serve, across a portfolio that spans the full range of Meta's products with a growing emphasis on the AI\-powered experiences Meta is building.This role suits someone who is comfortable operating across a shared portfolio, who treats AI as both a subject of testing and a tool for delivering testing faster, and who can manage several product lines and geographies by prioritizing work based on impact and stakeholder needs.  

  

  

### **Program Manager, International Testing Responsibilities:**

* Own the Active Payments Testing program end\-to\-end, partnering with our external testing vendor to execute in\-country payment tests using real local payment methods across priority markets
* Own the Passive / Payment Credentials program — sourcing, provisioning, and lifecycle management of real payment instruments (cards, bank accounts, SIMs, merchant accounts) for Meta teams testing payment flows that test credentials cannot cover
* Partner with Meta privacy, legal, compliance, finance, and enterprise infrastructure teams to onboard, train, prioritize, and manage testing vendors, and to ensure payment instrument sourcing and handling meets Meta requirements
* Engage and build relationships with cross\-functional payments, product, and engineering stakeholders to drive adoption and maximize market coverage of both programs
* Partner with Quality Assurance and payments engineering leads to craft functional payment testing strategies for priority markets, products, and payment methods
* Design and implement scalable frameworks for in\-country payment test coverage, prioritizing markets and payment methods by product and business impact
* Improve scalability through automation and standardization of test execution, credential provisioning, and reporting, while ensuring maximum value to Meta payment experiences
* Utilize signals from payment testing outcomes to determine actions that improve payment success rates and product quality

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 3\+ years of experience in program management, including experience shipping large\-scale global products
* Experience managing external vendors or outsourced delivery partners against defined quality and coverage requirements
* Track record of gaining alignment with cross\-organization stakeholders with competing priorities and goals
* Experience aggregating, analyzing, and interpreting complex data sets to inform business decisions
* Skilled in building simple and optimized workflows to support complex product launches
* Experience communicating and driving results with a variety of cross\-functional stakeholders, working across time zones and international offices
* Track record of staying focused, prioritizing, and creating structure across large, ambiguous programs, and setting goals for long\-term initiatives

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience operating programs that require handling of financially sensitive assets under compliance, privacy, or audit requirements
* Experience in corporate business management, finance, and compliance
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* A thorough understanding of product Quality Assurance processes and best practices
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience in payments, fintech, or financial services, including familiarity with local and alternative payment methods across international markets
* Knowledge of additional languages other than English, to support testing coordination with in\-country vendors and stakeholders across international markets

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. new_jobs.title: Supply Chain Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
***The Company***


Halo Industries has developed breakthrough technology to revolutionize a decades\-old semiconductor material slicing process. Our laser\-based solution minimizes waste, enhances material cost efficiency, and drives innovations across high\-growth markets, including automotive, telecommunications, and power electronics. Founded in 2014 at Stanford University, Halo received significant funding in 2024, paving the way for rapid expansion, strategic customer engagement, and the launch of volume manufacturing.

***The Opportunity***


We are seeking a highly strategic and technical Commodity Business Manager to join our supply chain team. In this role, you will be responsible for sourcing and managing both the highly specialized raw materials required for our wafers and the critical electromechanical components needed to build our proprietary manufacturing equipment.


You will also develop comprehensive sourcing strategies, manage robust supplier relationships, drive cost and quality improvements, and lead complex procurement processes.

***Key Responsibilities***


Strategic Sourcing \& Category Management

* Develop and Execute Commodity Strategies: Create comprehensive, multi\-year sourcing strategies for raw materials and capital equipment sub\-components.
* Market Intelligence: Continuously monitor global market conditions, raw material indices, and geopolitical factors impacting the semiconductor and supply chains. Conduct deep market research and analysis to identify technological trends, evaluate supplier capabilities, and proactively identify potential global risks within assigned commodity categories
* Dual\-Sourcing Initiatives: Identify, qualify, and onboard primary and secondary suppliers to mitigate risk and eliminate single points of failure in the supply chain.


Supplier Relationship Management

* Contract Negotiation: Lead complex negotiations for Master Supply Agreements, Statements of Work, and pricing contracts.
* Performance Monitoring: Conduct regular Quarterly Business Reviews with key suppliers to evaluate performance against rigorous Quality, Cost, Delivery, and Innovation metrics.
* Capacity Planning: Work closely with suppliers to ensure their manufacturing capacity aligns with our long\-term production forecasts and equipment build schedules.
* Supplier Relations: Research, select, and manage strategic suppliers; conduct performance reviews, monitor KPIs (quality, delivery), and negotiate contracts.


Cross\-Functional Leadership

* New Product Introduction: Partner with R\&D and the NPI Team during the design phase of new tools to ensure Design for Manufacturability and supply chain viability.
* Cost Reduction: Collaborate with engineering and manufacturing to identify Value Analysis/Value Engineering opportunities, thereby driving down the Bill of Materials cost
* Escalation Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for critical supply shortages, leading cross\-functional task forces to resolve bottlenecks and prevent production downtime.
* Program Management: Collaborate daily with Supply Chain, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, NPI, and Finance teams to align commodity strategies with overall business objectives, production schedules, and product design phases. Participate in corporate continuous improvement initiatives to enhance end\-to\-end supply chain processes, reduce lifecycle costs, and mitigate risks.

  

**Requirements** **Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering (Mechanical, Materials Science, or Electrical), Business, or a related field.
* 8\+ years of experience in strategic sourcing, commodity management, or supply chain within the semiconductor, capital equipment, or advanced materials industries.
* Proficiency reading engineering drawings and understand complex technical specifications related to both raw materials (purity levels, material properties) and equipment components (tolerances, vacuum standards).
* Experience performing complex cost modeling, Should\-Cost analysis, and Total Cost of Ownership evaluations.
* Experience utilizing ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite) and PLM software (e.g., Arena).
* Direct experience in the semiconductor or related high\-tech industries.
* Direct experience supporting New Product Introductions (NPI), including supplier selection and qualification for engineering prototypes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced negotiation skills with a history of executing favorable long\-term contracts in volatile markets.
* Experience developing and executing successful, long\-term global commodity sourcing strategies for specialized materials or capital equipment components.
* Familiarity with global supply chain management complexity, geopolitical factors, and risk mitigation planning.
* Experience with the complexities of compliance driven procurement for automotive or IATF 16949\.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.

**Other Requirements**

* This is a full\-time role primarily based onsite at our Santa Clara, CA office.
* Some domestic and international travel may be required (up to 10%).

 **Benefits**  

* Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision)
* Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
* Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick \& Public Holidays)
* Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary \& AD\&D)
* Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
* Free Food \& Snacks
* Stock Option Plan
* Annual Bonus Plan eligible
* Short Term \& Long Term Disability
* Base Salary: $140,000 \- $160,000

*Additional Information*


We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all team members feel valued and supported. We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, including those from underrepresented communities in STEM. If you meet most of the qualifications and are excited about this opportunity, we encourage you to apply.

Meta's RCP function enables the company to build products that withstand regulatory scrutiny and to meet global content and platform\-accountability obligations at scale. Within RCP, the Integrity Examinations \& Audit (E\&A) team owns Meta's readiness for, and execution of, external audit engagements — including the independent audit required under the EU Digital Services Act (DSA), youth and teen safety examinations, and other integrity\-related audits and regulatory examinations.We are seeking an Integrity Program Manager to own one or more integrity audit subject matter areas within E\&A. new_jobs.description:
Account Manager\-Utility Company

**Overview**
------------

  

Company Overview:
Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.**Job Description**
-------------------

  

Allied Universal® is hiring an Account Manager. As an Account Manager, you will lead the day\-to\-day security operations for a highly visible client, protecting people, property, assets, and business operations while building a high\-performing security team. You will lead with professionalism, accountability, and sound judgment—assessing risks, managing incidents, strengthening client and employee relationships, and ensuring the account consistently delivers quality service and operational excellence. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact while supporting both Allied Universal’s culture and the mission of a client whose services enable businesses and people to operate every day. **Why Join Allied Universal?*** **Career Growth:** Opportunities to advance within a global leader in security services
* **Impactful Work:** Play a vital leadership role in protecting people, property, assets, and business operations
* **Supportive Team:** Work alongside professionals committed to safety, service, and operational excellence

**RESPONSIBILITIES:*** **Lead Security Operations:** Own day\-to\-day account operations, ensuring the protection of people, property, assets, and business operations while maintaining high\-quality security services
* **Lead and Develop Security Teams:** Hire, coach, develop, motivate, recognize, and retain security officers and supervisors while maintaining clear accountability and a strong customer service mindset
* **Manage Risk and Incidents:** Assess, identify, communicate, and manage security risks, operational issues, incidents, and emergency situations; make timely decisions and appropriately engage client and Allied Universal leadership when escalation or additional support is needed
* **Strengthen Client Relationships:** Serve as a trusted account leader and primary partner to client executives, business partners, employees, and visitors, communicating regularly regarding program performance, risks, incidents, staffing needs, emerging issues, and recommended solutions
* **Support Client Culture and Mission:** Develop a strong understanding of the client’s business, culture, mission, operating environment, and security needs while fostering alignment between the client and Allied Universal
* **Drive Operational Excellence:** Ensure contract requirements, reporting, post orders, procedures, training, compliance expectations, and site\-specific operating standards are consistently met
* **Manage Staffing and Financial Performance:** Meet contractual scheduled hours through effective management of staffing, scheduling, overtime, payroll, billing, and other operational processes while supporting financial goals
* **Coordinate Training and Onboarding:** Partner with recruiting and support teams to identify, interview, hire, onboard, and retain quality candidates; coordinate and/or conduct site\-specific onboarding, on\-the\-job training, client\-specific training, and annual refresher training
* **Manage Resources and Readiness:** Maintain appropriate inventories and readiness of uniforms, equipment, supplies, vehicles, and other account resources
* **Use Business Systems:** Utilize business systems, including WinTeam, for scheduling, billing, reporting, and operational management, interpreting information and taking appropriate follow\-up action
* **Maintain Compliance:** Enforce Allied Universal policies and ensure employee concerns are appropriately addressed while maintaining accurate personnel records and account documentation

**QUALIFICATIONS (MUST HAVE):*** Four\-year degree in Criminal Justice, Business Administration, Security Management, or a related field preferred; a degree may be substituted with ten (10\) years of proven security leadership experience in a corporate environment
* At least two (2\) years of business management, operations, supervisory, or account leadership experience; additional experience may be required based on the size and scope of the client account

The Product Operations Lead is a part of the store leadership team responsible for executing on the store product strategy, including product operations and inventory management. They are responsible for leading inventory shifts, overseeing all back of house (BOH) product operations, and ensuring both the floor and BOH are stocked and well\-organized. The Product Operations Lead provides input to team member performance evaluations, recommendations into store hiring decisions, and acts as Supervisor on Duty (SOD) while leading inventory shifts. The ideal candidate will be an expert in data modeling, live in Excel and BI tools, and play a key role in annual planning, performance measurement, and providing high\-urgency strategic analysis for the CRO, CEO, and Board.
### **WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

* **Data Analysis \& Insights:** Analyze core metrics (pipeline health, bookings, retention/churn, product usage, and ARR trends) to identify risks, opportunities, and performance drivers. Perform detailed cohort, segmentation, and funnel analysis.
* **Reporting \& Dashboarding:** Own the creation and maintenance of executive\-level dashboards (Salesforce, Looker/Tableau, or equivalent). Produce weekly business reviews, monthly KPI reports, and materials that support the C\-level and Board reporting process.
* **Forecasting \& Modeling:** Support the bookings forecast process and ensure sales data integrity within the CRM. Maintain and refine predictive models for capacity planning, rep productivity, territory performance, and support quota\-setting exercises.
* **Cross\-Functional Reporting Support:** Partner with Sales Management, Marketing Ops, CS Ops, and Product Ops to unify data sources and workflows (Salesforce, Pendo, Gainsight, Marketo, Snowflake, etc.). Ensure consistent data definitions and reporting standards across functions to support end\-to\-end funnel attribution.
* **Annual and Quarterly Planning:** Provide data\-driven insights to support annual and quarterly GTM initiatives, including quota\-setting, territory modeling, and headcount planning.
* **Process Measurement \& Optimization:** Measure the impact of new processes and enablement programs. Track KPI performance, identify GTM process breakdowns, and recommend operational changes to enhance efficiency and productivity.
* **Ad\-hoc Executive Analysis:** Respond quickly to high\-urgency requests from the VP of RevOps, CRO, and CFO with clean, accurate deep dives on win rates, product sales performance, ASP, churn drivers, and related strategic topics.

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Business Analytics, or related field.
* 5\-7\+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, FP\&A, or Business Analytics.
* Expert\-level proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets ( (index/match, nested logic, pivot tables, scenario modeling).
* Proficiency in Salesforce reporting and Business Intelligence (BI) tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, PowerBI, SQL, Python).
* Strong understanding of core SaaS metrics (ARR, NRR, CAC/LTV, pipeline conversion rates).

* High attention to detail, comfort working with large datasets, and a proven ability to execute quickly in a fast\-paced environment.

**PURPOSE**
-----------



APR Consulting Co is a strategic production consultancy at the forefront of the advertising industry and is seeking a CONTRACT PROJECT MANAGER to join our team.


**DEFINING SUCCESS FOR THIS ROLE**
----------------------------------



This position will be successful if they can demonstrate the following objectives and performance targets:


* Contribute to the overall financial health and success of our account portfolio by effectively supporting the Client Solutions team. This includes managing staffing and labor on project schedules, developing pricing and scope, and ensuring the internal planning and delivery of project deliverables.
* Act as a key partner to Group Directors, Managing Advisors, and other stakeholders. Assist in guiding the development, management, and delivery of scoped deliverables while assessing resource allocation and profitability.
* Challenge traditional methods and bring forward new ideas. Demonstrate a proactive approach by influencing internal processes and operational standards. Effectively manage and influence both peers and leadership, driving accountability and fostering a culture of continuous improvement across the organization.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
------------------------



This position’s key responsibilities include but are not limited to the following:



Account \& Portfolio Governance


* Oversee Client Solutions account performance, including labor tracking, billing accuracy, risk management, and scope adherence.
* Ensure scopes, deliverables, and services remain aligned with business objectives.
* Conduct impact analyses for scope changes and recommend next steps.
* Develop understanding of client scopes of work, cost outs, contracts and billing requirements – and manage to those goals
* Facilitate retrospectives, document lessons learned, and refine portfolio management processes.

Project Management Support


* Proactively maximize bandwidth by balancing core responsibilities with supplemental client and/or internal engagements, bridging resource gaps and support for PMO leadership.
* Offer peer coverage and assist with overflow workloads when needed.

Resource \& Staffing Coordination


* Contribute to the understanding of company capacity and individual capabilities through tracking what available personnel are working on now and in the future and identify any gaps
* Partner with Resource Management to resolve resource conflicts, determine workloads, and optimize utilization across accounts.
* Support Group Directors in resource allocation, tracking, and prioritization.
* Track project/retainer actuals against SOW hours, deliverables, or project counts.

Project Workflow \& Operations


* Lead effort to achieve project objectives
* Work with team to accurately scope out length and difficulty of tasks and projects
* Responsible for ensuring agreed\-upon project tasks are completed within scope, time, budget and quality constraints
* Support end\-to\-end account workflow including time management, scope delivery, and risk prioritization.
* Risk Planning – anticipate problems and roadblocks, engage in contingency planning and recommend solutions or alternative methods to negate risks
* Maintain process documentation, operational policies, production calendars, timelines, and reports.
* Schedule internal and client meetings; maintain documentation, file structure, and naming conventions.
* Manage team schedules, deadlines, reporting workflows, and client reporting calendar
* Seek opportunities to engage others in procedural improvements
* Engage in client business to larger degree, establishing strong ties with your Client Solutions leads and attending as many client meetings as possible
* Measure performance against goals

Business \& Financial Management


* Partner with Group Directors and Client Services on SOWs and staffing plans.
* Create and review project/retainer cost\-outs and track actuals against budget.
* Review burn reports, monitor contribution margins, and recommend adjustments to maintain financial alignment.
* Maintain detailed record of scope changes
* Manage financial milestones in APR systems and coordinate payment reconciliation with finance.
* Participate in monthly finance and billing reviews.

Departmental Contribution


* Collaborate, share knowledge, and support a culture of consistency, compliance, and operational excellence across teams—including global teams.
* Support the development, improvement and use of all company collaboration, archival and financial tools and systems to improve process and get work done efficiently

  

**ABOUT YOU**
-------------


* 6\-8 years experience as a Project Manager, Senior Project Manager, or similar in advertising/marketing industry
* PMP Certification (Project Management Professional) or actively working to obtain certification desired
* Proficiency in Google Workspace
* Experience with Deltek Workbook or Deltek products is a plus.
* Excellent communication skills (verbal and written).
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and adaptable.
* Calm and focused under pressure; assertive conflict\-resolution and problem\-solving skills.
* Effective decision\-maker, even under tight deadlines.
* Demonstrates confidence, professionalism, and diplomacy.
* Capable of establishing strong relationships and gaining trust from peers.
* Positive, collaborative, and solutions\-oriented.
* Embraces technology advancements and process changes.
* Future\-focused and technologically adept.
* Good listener, takes feedback well, and addresses problems.
* Lead, motivate and inspire with compassion and vision

**OMEGA SYSTEMS JOB DESCRIPTION**
=================================

**Position:** Project Manager  

**Reports To:** VP of Service Delivery
  

**Division:** Technical Services
  

**FSLA:** Exempt  

  

This role is responsible for executing projects within established timelines, budgets, and quality standards while coordinating Systems Engineers and Project Engineers responsible for implementation. While not hands on technical, the Project Manager must possess strong technical literacy to translate SOWs into actionable plans, manage dependencies and risk, and ensure successful project delivery. You will partner with Engineers, CSMs, Account Managers, and clients to provide clear status reporting, maintain documentation, and uphold PMP based project management practices in a fast paced environment.


**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead project delivery from SOW to closeout: develop project plans, define milestones, resource assignments, acceptance criteria, and change control processes.
* Consolidate and prioritize multiple concurrent projects across accounts: maintain program level roadmaps, identify conflicts, sequence work to optimize engineer utilization and client impact.
* Coordinate cross functional stakeholders: work with Engineers, CSMs, AMs, and third party vendors to align expectations, scope, schedules, and deliverables.
* Resource and schedule management: assign engineers to tasks based on skills and availability, monitor workload, proactively rebalance assignments, and support time management to meet SLAs and timelines.
* Communication and reporting: produce and distribute regular status updates, executive summaries, project dashboards, and risk/issue logs to internal teams and client stakeholders.
* Risk, issue, and change control: identify and document risks, own mitigation plans, manage scope change requests, and obtain approvals per governance processes.
* Meeting facilitation and client engagement: run project kickoff, steering committee, and weekly status meetings; present technical progress in business terms for non technical stakeholders.
* Quality and acceptance: ensure engineers produce required technical deliverables (design docs, runbooks, test plans) and that acceptance criteria in the SOW are validated and signed off.
* Continuous improvement: capture lessons learned, refine project templates, and share best practices to improve delivery efficiency and documentation quality.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* PMP certification with 5\+ years managing technical projects; MSP experience preferred.
* Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent projects and consolidating workstreams into program level plans.
* Technical literacy across cloud, networking, virtualization, and server technologies to meaningfully guide engineers and translate technical status for stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder management skills: proven experience working with client executives, CSMs, AMs, technical teams, and vendors.
* Excellent written and verbal communication: status reports, executive summaries, and client facing updates.
* Solid scheduling and resource management skills: familiarity with MS Project, Smartsheet, or equivalent; comfortable optimizing engineer assignments and availability.
* Risk and change management proficiency: establish and run escalation paths, change approval workflows, and issue resolution processes.
* Process orientation and documentation skills: create and maintain project artifacts, RACI matrices, runbooks, and acceptance checklists.
* Comfortable with tools common in MSP environments: ConnectWise or similar PSA, IT Glue, and collaboration platforms (Teams/SharePoint/Confluence).
* Ability to manage multiple customers and prioritize expedited activities.
* Ability to travel occasionally for client meetings or on site project phases.

**Desired Certifications \& Knowledge**

* PMP; Agile/Scrum experience a plus.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS) and networking fundamentals is strongly preferred.
* Experience with financial/project tracking tools and familiarity with MSP billing/renewal cycles.

**Location \& Schedule**

* Hybrid or remote with periodic on site client engagements and occasional travel
* Flexible hours to accommodate clients and engineer coordination across time zones
* Incumbent(s) in this position may be required to perform other duties and special assignments not specifically stated.

**Environmental**: The job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, etc.

**Travel Requirements**: Minimal travel is required for this position.

Associate’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience
