new_jobs.description:
Position Overview  



dormakaba is seeking a remote Project Manager to support the dormakaba product lines within our Airport Division (ESC), including coordination with Field Service. The Project Manager will be responsible for managing all aspects of new installation and site modernization projects following contract award, from project initiation through completion. This role will coordinate closely with customers, Sales, Field Service, vendors, subcontractors, and internal teams to ensure projects are delivered on time, within contract budget, and in accordance with customer expectations, project requirements, and dormakaba standards.  



HIRING SALARY RANGE: Base Salary $90,000 \- $120,000 (Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with market data.) Please visit our career site for more information on benefits.


What you will do  

  

  



* Manage multiple projects of varying size and complexity while coordinating activities with appropriate vendors, subcontractors, branch staff, and internal stakeholders
* Ensure a smooth and effective transition of projects from the Sales team to the Project Fulfillment team, ensuring all required information, scope, documentation, and customer expectations are clearly communicated
* Develop comprehensive project plans by establishing timelines, resource requirements, staffing, funding, milestones, and project schedules
* Establish and achieve project financial objectives by developing budgets, scheduling and approving expenditures, analyzing budget variances, and initiating corrective actions as needed
* Negotiate and manage subcontractor agreements while ensuring subcontractors meet required qualifications, licensing, insurance, safety, and quality standards

What we require  

  

  



* High School Diploma or equivalent
* 3\+ years of project management experience, or 2\+ years of relevant project management experience with a bachelor’s degree
* Strong working knowledge of new construction processes, project coordination, and jobsite activities
* Working knowledge and experience with CRM systems and project management tools
* Valid, unrestricted state\-issued driver’s license and valid, unrestricted passport required for occasional travel within the U.S. and Canada
* Ability and willingness to travel up to 30% annually throughout the United States and Travel up to 30% annually within the US and Canada

What we prefer  

  

  



* Bachelor’s degree in technical discipline, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field
* PMP certificate
* Working knowledge of electronics is required; experience with access control, entrance systems, security solutions, or systems integration is strongly preferred.

What we offer  

  

  



* Taking Care of our Employees on Day One with Medical, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance coverage options. No waiting periods!
* Your health is our priority, we offer Medical Wellness Programs to aid in your well\-being
* Vacation and Personal Time Off
* We support your growing family; we provide Parental Leave for Moms and Dads!
* Wisely plan for your future with our 401k Matching plan beginning on Day One
* Supporting your career development with our Tuition Reimbursement Program
* Robust culture supporting internal advancement with our Learn and Grow Program
* 24/7 access to over 15,000 LinkedIn Learning courses to assist in your professional development and to expand on your individual interests.
* Employee Assistance Programs
* Voluntary Legal Insurance
* Unlimited Referral Reward Bonuses
Corporate Discounts for shopping, travel and more!  
* 

Who we are

new_jobs.title: Maintenance Training Manager
new_jobs.description:
The Maintenance Training Manager is responsible for developing, implementing, and managing technical training programs for aircraft maintenance personnel within the organization. This position ensures maintenance training programs meet FAA regulations, OEM standards, and internal safety and quality requirements.



The Maintenance Training Manager oversees training schedules, tracks certifications, conducts audits, evaluates training effectiveness, and works closely with Maintenance, Quality, Safety, Operations, Human Resources, and other organizational stakeholders to ensure maintenance personnel remain proficient, compliant, and prepared to support safe air medical operations.

  


**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**


* Design, develop, implement, and maintain comprehensive technical training programs for maintenance personnel.
* Develop training materials including presentations, manuals, assessments, interactive e learning modules, and other instructional resources.
* Conduct training\-needs assessments and identify skill, competency, and performance gaps.
* Deliver engaging training through classroom instruction, hands\-on demonstrations, virtual learning, simulations, group discussions, and other instructional methods.
* Conduct audits to ensure compliance with company policies and applicable industry regulations.
* Review existing training programs and recommend enhancements to improve engagement, learning, retention, and effectiveness.
* Organize and conduct monthly induction and orientation sessions.
* Maintain current knowledge of maintenance software systems, industry best practices, software releases, and emerging technologies.
* Provide ongoing technical support and guidance to maintenance personnel regarding maintenance software systems and functionality.
* Maintain accurate training records, attendance documentation, evaluations, and training materials.
* Prepare reports regarding training outcomes, effectiveness, and opportunities for improvement.
* Develop and maintain knowledge resources for maintenance software systems.
* Collaborate with Maintenance, Quality, Safety, Operations, Human Resources, Regional Managers, software vendors, and other stakeholders.
* Participate in cross\-functional projects requiring maintenance training expertise.

 **Minimum Required Qualifications**


* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Working knowledge of aircraft maintenance practices, technical documentation, maintenance records, and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Demonstrated experience training, mentoring, coaching, or providing technical instruction to maintenance personnel.
* Ability to develop and deliver effective training through classroom instruction, hands\-on demonstrations, virtual learning, and/or other instructional methods.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and ability to learn and effectively utilize maintenance, training, and learning\-management software systems.
* Ability to simultaneously manage multiple training initiatives, schedules, records, and compliance requirements.
* Ability to work collaboratively across Maintenance, Quality, Safety, Operations, Human Resources, and other organizational departments.
* Ability to travel as required and work a flexible schedule when operational or training needs require.
* Valid driver's license.
* Regular and reliable attendance.

  


**Preferred Qualifications**


* FAA Airframe and Powerplant (A\&P) Mechanic Certificate.
* Experience developing, implementing, or managing a formal aviation maintenance training program.
* Experience operating within an FAA Part 135 and/or Part 145 environment.
* Fixed\-wing and/or rotor\-wing aircraft maintenance experience.
* Experience developing curricula, presentations, technical manuals, assessments, e\-learning content, or other instructional materials.
* Knowledge of adult\-learning principles, instructional design, competency\-based training, and training evaluation methods.
* Experience conducting or supporting maintenance audits, quality assurance activities, regulatory inspections, or compliance reviews.
* Experience with computerized maintenance tracking systems, Learning Management Systems (LMS), and electronic training\-record systems.
* Familiarity with FAA regulations, OEM maintenance requirements, Airworthiness Directives, Service Bulletins, and other applicable technical or regulatory guidance.
* Experience analyzing training needs, identifying competency or performance gaps, and implementing corrective training.
* Experience within air medical, EMS aviation, or another safety\-sensitive aviation environment.

  


**Working Conditions \& Physical Requirements**  

This position primarily operates in an office environment with occasional exposure to hangar facilities. The position requires prolonged periods of sitting and computer work, frequent verbal and written communication, and the ability to read documents and computer screens.



The position may require lifting up to 50 pounds, navigating organizational facilities, traveling as needed, and working a flexible schedule, including occasional evenings and weekends. Occasional exposure to hazardous materials, loud noise, and extreme temperatures may occur.

The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned from time to time. The scope of the job may change as necessitated by business demands.



The employee must be able to perform the essential functions of the position satisfactorily and that, if requested, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable employees with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their job, absent undue hardship.

At the birth of digital, Claravine noticed a persistent problem with data integrity. This discovery led to a unique category solution that continues to redefine how top brands and agencies manage the digital experience. We take the drama out of data by standardizing data at the source, giving people, teams and technology a shared understanding of their data.

  

What We Do



Claravine is The Data Standards Company. **This role will start as a 1099 contractor for 90 days and then have the opportunity to go full time.**
**The role is open to US, Canada, and Western Europe ONLY.**

**About TNT Growth**
===========================================================================================================================================================================================


TNT Growth is a performance marketing agency operating at the intersection of growth strategy, paid media, and creative production for DTC and B2B brands. We’re a remote\-first team of 30\+ people running on EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) and building the operational infrastructure to scale.

**About This Role**
===================


We’re hiring a Business Operations Associate to join our team on a contract\-to\-hire basis. This role has two phases:

**Phase 1 (Weeks 1–12\):** You’ll serve as interim operational coverage during a planned leadership leave, working directly with the CEO and department leads across finance, people operations, and company operations. This is a high\-trust, high\-visibility period where you’ll keep critical business functions running smoothly.

**Phase 2 (Ongoing):** Once the leave period ends, the role transitions to its permanent scope — owning the day\-to\-day of people operations support, project management, operational reporting, and cross\-functional coordination. If the contract goes well, you convert to full\-time with an expanded seat on the business operations team.

**Phase 1: Interim Responsibilities (Weeks 1–12\)**
===================================================


During the leave period, you will be the operational point person across finance and company operations. The CEO will retain final decision\-making authority, but you are responsible for the day\-to\-day execution, triage, and follow\-through.

**Finance Operations**

* **Contractor invoice review:** Review incoming contractor invoices against the financial forecast. Flag discrepancies, missing costs, or new vendors not yet in projections to Finance and escalate to the CEO as needed.
* **Cost tracker oversight:** Periodically review the cost tracker for accuracy. Verify invoice numbers, identify unbilled client costs, and flag billing discrepancies (e.g., clients being served without signed agreements or deposits on file).
* **Subscription and credit card management:** Maintain the master list of software subscriptions across all departments — tracking which tool is on which card and who owns it. Catch orphaned subscriptions, duplicate tools, and charges on the wrong card. Coordinate card migrations when team members depart or change roles.
* **Headcount and software request triage:** Monitor the automated approval workflow in Slack for new headcount and software purchase requests. Ensure business cases are complete and route to Finance and the CEO for approval. Work with people \& talent lead to determine salary range for roles.
* **Finance meeting support:** Help prepare for and support periodic finance review meetings. Track action items, follow up on open billing issues, and ensure recurring reviews happen on schedule.
* **End\-of\-quarter and year\-end support:** Assist Finance with quarterly close activities and budget reconciliation. Support year\-end planning by gathering data, tracking deadlines, and coordinating across departments.

**Company Operations**

* **Executive meeting support:** Prepare agendas, track action items, and maintain documentation for the weekly executive meeting. Ensure follow\-through on decisions made in leadership meetings.
* **Operating system support:** Help maintain and reinforce the company’s EOS implementation — ensure scorecard data is updated, rocks are tracked, and meeting cadences are followed across departments.
* **Contract management support:** Support Client Success and Sales with active contract management — tracking signature status on addendums, SOWs, and new agreements. Flag renewals and ensure in\-progress contracts don’t stall.
* **End\-of\-year performance planning:** Work with the CEO and executive team to determine what end\-of\-year performance evaluation looks like and support the planning process.
* **Cross\-department coordination:** Serve as the operational connective tissue between Finance, People Ops, Client Success, and department leads. Triage incoming operational requests and route them to the right owner.
* **Performance review execution:** Partner with the People \& Talent Lead to execute the end\-of\-year performance review cycle — coordinating timelines, compiling self\-assessments and manager feedback, and ensuring reviews are completed on schedule across all departments.

**Phase 2: Ongoing Responsibilities**
=====================================


After the leave period, this role settles into its permanent scope. You’ll continue to own and build on the areas below as the company scales.

**People Operations**

* **Headcount approval coordination:** Guide new headcount requests from reviewing the business case through budget approval to confirming the job description with People Operations/Recruiting. Ensure requests are complete and well\-documented before routing to Finance and the CEO for final sign\-off.
* **Offboarding support:** Assist with managing offboarding checklists in ClickUp as needed — coordinating system access removal, Gusto deactivation, and final day logistics.
* **Payroll support:** Work with Finance to add new hires to payroll, ensuring accurate start dates, compensation, and classification. Not all team members are on Gusto — coordinate across platforms for global employees.
* **SOP and policy development:** Assist People Operations with the creation of new standard operating procedures and company policies as needs arise.
* **Training material review:** Review and offer insight on training slide decks and materials created by People Operations, ensuring accuracy and alignment with company standards.
